Defence-Tech-Scale-up · C-UAS / Drohnenabwehrsysteme · München

Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes europäisches Defence-Tech-Unternehmen, das technologisch anspruchsvolle unbemannte Systeme für militärische Anwender entwickelt und bereits international im Markt aktiv ist.

Für die nächste Wachstumsphase suchen wir einen Chief Technology Officer (m/w/d), der die Verantwortung für Engineering und die technologische Weiterentwicklung des Produktportfolios übernimmt.

Die Rolle verbindet strategische Technologieverantwortung mit Organisationsaufbau: Du skalierst eine bereits etablierte Engineering-Organisation, entwickelst die Produktarchitektur weiter und treibst den Ausbau eines zukunftsorientierten Portfolios software-definierter Produkte voran, das Hardware und Software zu integrierten Lösungen vereint.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Engineering-Organisation
  • Du baust eine belastbare zweite Führungsebene mit Engineering- und Team-Leads auf und rekrutierst dafür die passenden Führungskräfte
  • Du entwickelst Strukturen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Ownership so weiter, dass Engineering auch bei starkem Wachstum effizient funktioniert
  • Du stellst Projekt- und Produktteams mit den richtigen technischen Kompetenzen zusammen
  • Du stärkst Software Engineering innerhalb der Organisation und entwickelst Hardware- und Softwareentwicklung zu einer integrierten software-defined Entwicklung weiter
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Management die technologische Ausrichtung neuer Produkte
  • Du stellst sicher, dass neue Entwicklungen nicht nur als kurzfristige Prototypen entstehen, sondern architektonisch die Grundlage für ein skalierbares und ausbaufähiges Produktportfolio bilden
  • Du entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit und Abgrenzung zwischen Engineering und Product Management weiter
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Business Development und Product zusammen und bewertest neue Kundenanforderungen hinsichtlich technischer Machbarkeit, Aufwand und strategischem Fit
  • Du bist technischer Sparringspartner des Gründers und des übrigen Managementteams

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Führungs- und Managementerfahrung in technischen Organisationen
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Skalierung von Engineering-Teams
  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Defence-Umfeld und ein gutes Verständnis militärischer Nutzer, Anforderungen und Rahmenbedingungen
  • Ein ausgeprägtes software-defined Mindset bei gleichzeitig gutem Verständnis physischer Systeme
  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Produkten, bei denen Hardware und Software eng zusammenspielen
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Embedded Software, Echtzeitsystemen, Robotik, autonomen Systemen oder vergleichbaren cyber-physischen Systemen
  • Berührungspunkte mit Hardwareentwicklung, beispielsweise Elektronik, Mechanik oder Verbundwerkstoffen
  • Ausreichende technische Tiefe, um Architekturentscheidungen einzuordnen und erfahrene Engineers fachlich zu führen
  • Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up oder Scale-up ist ein großer Vorteil

Ein Background bei einem etablierten Defence- oder Aerospace-Unternehmen kann ebenfalls sehr gut passen – insbesondere dann, wenn du bereits Erfahrung außerhalb klassischer Konzernstrukturen gesammelt hast.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir suchen nicht zwingend jemanden, der bereits CTO war.

Entscheidend ist, dass du die Führungs- und Managementerfahrung sowie die technische Reife mitbringst, um eine wachsende Engineering-Organisation zu führen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Du solltest strategisch denken können, gleichzeitig aber flexibel genug sein, technische Prioritäten anzupassen, wenn sich Kundenanforderungen, Technologien oder operative Rahmenbedingungen verändern.

Ein starrer Mehrjahresplan passt weniger zu dieser Rolle als die Fähigkeit, eine klare technologische Richtung vorzugeben und diese bei Bedarf schnell an neue Realitäten anzupassen.

Was dich erwartet

  • Eine C-Level-Rolle mit direkter Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer
  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum bei Technologie, Organisation und Produktentwicklung
  • Verantwortung für eine bereits etablierte und weiter wachsende Engineering-Organisation
  • Die Möglichkeit, den Übergang hin zu einer stärker software-defined Produktentwicklung maßgeblich zu gestalten
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem, Product Management, Business Development und dem übrigen Management
  • Ein schnell wachsendes Defence-Tech-Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Standort München mit regelmäßiger persönlicher Präsenz beim Engineering-Team

data.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Why this role exists

You’ll help build Neko’s clinical organisation in Germany from the ground up, and then lead the people strategy that helps it scale.

Neko’s clinics are where our mission comes to life. The experience members have is shaped by the teams behind it, making the organisation itself one of the most important products we build. In Germany, this organisation doesn’t exist yet. Before the first clinic opens, you’ll help define clinical roles, workforce planning, compensation, and the employee experience that attracts exceptional talent. Then, as clinics launch and grow, you’ll partner with leaders to ensure those teams perform, develop, and scale successfully.

This is a rare opportunity to build an organisation from day one – and to shape what it becomes as Neko brings prevention-first healthcare to another market.

Phase one: build the foundation, pre-launch

  • Ensure the German employment framework is appropriately set up with legal, external counsel, key internal teams, like People Ops and Workforce Planning – contracts, working-time and rostering models, pay structures, policies, payroll and people systems

  • Design the clinic organisation from a blank sheet, and a staffing model sized to Neko’s ambition for the market rather than to the first clinic

  • Own the launch workforce plan, the cover and contracting model, and reward in a German context – pay, pension, equity

  • Build a German clinical employer proposition from zero with TA, and a playbook the next market can reuse

Build for German employment structures from day one

  • Design workforce policies (scheduling, pay, performance) with German labor law and employee representation requirements in mind from the start

  • Work with legal counsel to determine the right structure for German clinic operations

  • Ensure people systems and tools are built to comply with German labor regulations

Phase two: run clinical people strategy live

  • Be the day-to-day People partner across German clinical leadership, from senior operations and medical leaders through to frontline clinic managers

  • Spend real time in clinics, and read what members experience there as signal about how teams are resourced, structured and led – spotting strain, inconsistency or risk early, because it usually shows up in the clinic room before it shows up in the data

  • Coach clinic leaders through hiring, performance and the conversations that are hard but important – and build the leadership capability and multi-way feedback culture that keep employee relations issues from piling up, while supporting teams and leaders through the ones that do

  • Support first-time clinic managers as they build confidence, capability and steady leadership habits

  • Hold the staffing model against the growth plan: German absence, leave and part-time realities, the clinical qualification and mobility pipeline, and honesty when the plan and the labour market disagree

  • Turn central People programmes into clinic-ready practice, and call out where a centralised approach misses frontline reality

  • Revisit what you built pre-launch as clinics run, and put data and AI to work in how the People agenda actually operates – sharper decisions, less manual effort, more time on the judgement calls

  • Take change from decision to genuine adoption, bringing clinic teams with you without pausing delivery to do it

Beyond Germany

  • Help drive the global People Partner team’s clinical strategy rather than just feed into it

  • Bring the German clinical reality into that team's agenda, so decisions made at scale hold up on the ground

  • Support the wider European market as it grows, and other markets as needed

What you bring

  • 8+ years as a senior People or HR Business Partner leader, across senior levels of leadership and frontline leaders of larger teams

  • A builder's mindset – comfortable starting from a blank sheet, having opened or scaled operations in Germany or built a German people function from close to nothing

  • Deep, practical command of German employment law and co-determination, with the judgement to know when to bring in counsel

  • Germany is the core requirement; multi-market European experience is strongly preferred – you have worked across more than one European employment landscape (Sweden a significant plus) and know what scales beyond a single market

DEINE ROLLE

Du bist auf Instagram, LinkedIn & Co. zu Hause, hast ein gutes Gespür für Content und kannst selbst starke Posts, Reels und Stories produzieren? Du interessierst dich außerdem für Wirtschaft, Investments und die Welt rund um Vermögen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Als Social Media Manager (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns dabei, unsere Social-Media-Kanäle weiterzuentwickeln – von der ersten Content-Idee über die Produktion bis zur Veröffentlichung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Content-, Brand- und Podcast-Team zusammen und bringst deine eigenen Ideen und dein Gespür für guten Social Content ein.

Von Anfang an übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate. Ob Social Posts, Reels, Podcast-Clips oder Event-Content: Du hilfst uns dabei, komplexe Finanz- und Investmentthemen verständlich, relevant und visuell stark für Social Media aufzubereiten.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Social Media & Planung: Du betreust unsere Kanäle auf Instagram, LinkedIn und Facebook und planst gemeinsam mit dem Team, welche Themen und Formate wann und wo stattfinden.

  • Content Creation: Du entwickelst Posts, Carousels, Reels und Stories von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Gleichzeitig machst du aus bestehenden Inhalten wie Magazinartikeln, Marktkommentaren, Interviews, Events oder Expertengesprächen eigenständigen Social Content – von starken Hooks und Captions bis zu Recaps und Key Takeaways.

  • Podcast & Video: Du unterstützt bei der Produktion von That’s Smart Money und entwickelst aus unseren Gesprächen relevante Clips und Short-Form-Content. Dabei arbeitest du unter anderem mit Riverside und unseren Video-Tools.

  • Trends & neue Ideen: Du beobachtest, welche Formate und Mechaniken auf Social Media funktionieren, und überlegst, was davon zu LIQID passt. Gute Ideen sollst du bei uns nicht nur vorschlagen, sondern auch ausprobieren können.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Du verstehst Social Media und hast bereits selbst Content gemacht: Ob für einen eigenen Account, ein Projekt, dein Studium oder ein Unternehmen, ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, dass du ein gutes Gespür dafür hast, was auf Social Media funktioniert.

  • Du kannst Geschichten erzählen und richtig gut schreiben: Du erkennst den interessanten Gedanken in einem Thema, findest einen starken Einstieg und kannst auch komplexere Inhalte verständlich und präzise auf den Punkt bringen.

  • Du hast ein gutes visuelles Gespür und Lust auf Produktion: Fotografie, Typografie, Layout und Video interessieren dich und du setzt Content gerne selbst um. Erfahrung mit Riverside, CapCut, Premiere oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Du packst selbst an: Du arbeitest eigenständig und zuverlässig, bringst Ideen mit und hast Lust, Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate zu übernehmen.

  • Du bist neugierig auf Finanzthemen: Du musst noch kein Investment-Profi sein. Aber Wirtschaft, Märkte und Investments interessieren dich und du hast Lust, dich auch in komplexere Themen einzuarbeiten.

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team: Du hast Spaß daran, gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Content, Brand, Podcast und anderen Bereichen aus einer guten Idee richtig guten Content zu machen.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte – und geben dir gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit, LIQID und das Team kennenzulernen.

  • Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit unserer Social Media Managerin Verena: Wir tauschen uns darüber aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  • Kleine praktische Aufgabe: Du bekommst eine Aufgabe, die sich an typischen Themen aus deinem zukünftigen Arbeitsalltag orientiert. So sehen wir, wie du Content denkst und umsetzt – und du bekommst einen konkreten Eindruck von der Rolle.

  • Gespräch mit unserer Hiring Managerin Lenika & Team: Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle ein, sprechen über deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und geben dir einen Einblick in unsere Content- und Social-Media-Arbeit.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

data.title: Senior Project Developer (m/f/d)

data.description:
Über uns

Richte dich neu aus. Auf deine Zukunft. Mit velpTEC.

velpTEC ist ein auf innovative Technologien ausgerichtetes Weiterbildungsinstitut, das Erfahrungen aus Wirtschaft, Zukunftsforschung und neuen Bildungsansätzen verbindet. Wir unterstützen Menschen durch unsere Bildungsangebote praxisnah dabei, ihre Fähigkeiten für künftige Zeiten zu stärken und damit aktiv ihren Lebensweg zu gestalten. In unserem Handeln legen wir Wert auf gesellschaftliche Verantwortung, Fortschritt und Selbstbestimmung. 

Bereit für eine neue Mission? Dann entdecke jetzt deine Zukunftsperspektive bei velpTEC und werde Teil unseres multiprofessionellen und diversen Teams. 

Wir bauen unsere digitalen Produkte in einem neuen, KI-nativen Produktteam mit fünf klaren Rollen: Prototyper, Builder, Sweeper, Grower und Maintainer. Jede Rolle hat einen eigenen Auftrag im Lebenszyklus eines Produkts, von der ersten Idee bis zum verlässlichen Betrieb. Gearbeitet wird an unserem Online-Campus, unseren Websites, unserem Shop und an neuen KI-gestützten Lern- und Vertriebsprodukten. 

Du möchtest dafür sorgen, dass ein Produkt trägt, sobald Menschen sich darauf verlassen? Als Maintainer (m/w/d) hältst du unsere gereiften Systeme schnell, sicher und verfügbar, während Nutzendenzahlen und Funktionsumfang wachsen. Du automatisierst den Betrieb, machst den Zustand der Systeme jederzeit sichtbar und bringst Störungen strukturiert und ruhig zu Ende. Das Erfahrungslevel halten wir offen: Junior bis Senior ist möglich. Entscheidend ist deine Lust, gemeinsam mit KI-Werkzeugen großartige Ergebnisse zu gestalten.


Was deine Aufgaben sein werden

  • Verfügbarkeit & Performance: Monitoring, Alerting und Zielwerte für Verfügbarkeit und Antwortzeiten aufbauen und einhalten
  • Betrieb automatisieren: Deployments, Updates, Backups und Wiederherstellung über Infrastructure as Code und Pipelines abbilden
  • Störungen beheben: Vorfälle systematisch eingrenzen, beheben, Ursachen dokumentieren und Wiederholungen ausschließen
  • Sicherheit:Patches, Abhängigkeiten, Zugriffsrechte und Datenschutzanforderungen laufend im Blick behalten
  • Kosten & Kapazität: Cloud-Kosten transparent machen und Kapazitäten für Wachstum vorausplanen
  • Campus-Betrieb: Unsere Lernplattform mit dem externen Dienstleister stabil und aktuell halten
  • KI als Werkzeug: Log-Analysen, Runbooksund wiederkehrende Betriebsaufgaben mit KI-Werkzeugen beschleunigen
  • Zusammenarbeit: Übergaben mit Builder und Sweeper gestalten und Betriebswissen im Team verfügbar machen


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem technischen Bereich, zum Beispiel in Informatik, Engineering oder Computer Science
  • Erfahrung im Betrieb von Webanwendungen in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS, GCP oder Azure
  • Kenntnisse in Containern, CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code, zum Beispiel Docker, GitHub Actions und Terraform
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Monitoring und Observability, zum Beispiel Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry oder Uptime-Monitoring
  • Linux-Kenntnisse sowie Grundlagen in Netzwerk und Datenbankbetrieb inklusive Backups
  • Scripting- oder Entwicklungskenntnisse, zum Beispiel Python, Bash oderTypeScript
  • Erfahrung mit PHP- undMoodle-Umgebungen ist von Vorteil
  • Freude daran, KI-Werkzeuge für Analyse, Automatisierung und Dokumentation zu nutzen
  • Ruhige, systematische Fehlersuche und Verantwortungsbewusstsein für laufende Systeme
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und gute Englischkenntnisse


Was dich bei velpTEC erwartet

  • Vollständiges Home-Office oder hybrides Arbeiten an unseren Standorten in München, Leipzig oder Hannover
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Kernarbeitszeit – Arzttermine, Kita und andere wichtige Termine sind kein Problem
  • Fixgehalt + Provision + Zielbonus + 100 € (in Vollzeit) monatliche betriebliche Altersvorsorge nach 6 Monaten + 15 % Zuschuss auf Eigenanteil + attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte
  • 3 bezahlte Educational Days pro Jahr für Weiterbildungen + 1 zusätzlicher Urlaubstag für Ehrenamt
  • Einjährliches Gesundheitsbudget von 600 € (in Vollzeit) nach 6 Monaten + Zugang zu über 13.000 Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und gemeinsame Erlebnisse
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und Offenheit für neue Ideen und Innovationen

data.title: Maintainer (m/dw/d)

data.description:
Was erwartet dich?

Du liebst Rankingfaktoren, Keyword-Recherchen und die Suche nach Fehlern und Potenzialen – und verstehst, wie Suchmaschinen und KI-gestützte Suche funktionieren?

Dann wollen wir dich kennenlernen!


Als (Senior) SEO Specialist im Team von Projecter entwickelst du die organische Sichtbarkeit unserer Kund*innen nachhaltig weiter – in klassischen Suchmaschinen ebenso wie in KI-gestützten Suchsystemen. Du leitest eigene Projekte, baust deine Expertise aus und findest bei uns Raum für neue Ideen, spannende Kontakte und deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung.


Was solltest du mitbringen?

Was erwartet dich?

  • Projektverantwortung und eigenständige Entwicklung von SEO-Strategien – auch mit Blick auf KI-Suche (z. B. Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT)

  • Beratung und Performance-Optimierung komplexer Kund*innenprojekte

  • SEO-Analysen mit Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, ahrefs, Screaming Frog und Sistrix – und Umsetzung passender Maßnahmen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Content-Team, bei der du als SEO-Sparringspartner*in Themen, Recherchen und Texte begleitest und Inhalte fit für klassische und KI-Suche machst

  • Verständliche Aufbereitung der Ergebnisse in Reports und Präsentationen

  • Enger Austausch mit Kund*innen, inklusive Planung und Durchführung von Workshops

  • Entwicklung von Offpage-Strategien und nachhaltigem Linkaufbau, z. B. über digitale PR und Kooperationen 

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg*innen aus einem internationalen Agenturnetzwerk aus anderen Online-Marketing-Bereichen in übergreifenden Projekten

  • Als Senior: Du übernimmst zusätzlich fachliche Verantwortung im Team, begleitest Kolleg*innen und entwickelst unsere SEO-Ansätze weiter


Das bringst du mit:

Was bringst du mit?

  • Mindestens 1-2 Jahr Berufserfahrung im technischen SEO - auch bei komplexen Domains

  • Erfahrung im Agenturalltag: Du weißt, wie es ist, mehrere Kund*innenprojekte parallel zu betreuen, Prioritäten zu setzen und mit wechselnden Anforderungen umzugehen

  • Fundiertes Wissen zu Onpage- und Offpage-Faktoren sowie Verständnis von HTML, CSS und JavaScript (Programmieren musst du nicht können)

The Xsolla Money Account is a strategic initiative to build embedded financial services for gamers, creators, and developers. Sitting at the intersection of fintech and gaming, the Money Account enables new business models, creator monetization, and deeper player engagement.

data.description:
Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Europe can reindustrialize if we bring together AI X energy market opportunities X industrial processes. Europe's largest companies (~2% of total energy demand) make their energy decisions with our Energy OS. Behind it is RIZMO: our autonomous AI agent acts as a digital colleague that builds independently, analyzes continuously, iterates with energy management and uncovers cost-saving potential.

As a Field Value Engineer, you bring RIZMO directly to our industrial clients – with both feet on-site. You don't roll out a finished product; you actively build the engine: you train the agent with feedback from the field and make savings visible in euros and megawatt hours. Iteration cycles in hours, not quarters.

Tasks

Digital Twin: Build live models of entire energy systems – power, gas, steam, water, waste heat, generation and battery storage – including smart-meter and OPC UA integration.

Decision Hub: Develop scenarios, business cases, what-if analyses and investment roadmaps together with our clients.

Operation Hub: Support cross-site live optimization across day-ahead, intraday and grid services markets.

Autonomous Agent: Make RIZMO better – parsing technical documents, researching parameters, running optimizations, finding cost reductions – and feed every insight from the field straight back into the engine.

Commercial Ownership: Uncover unstated requirements from operators, plant managers and CFOs, defend business cases up to C-level, and measure your success in euros per unit saved.

Requirements

Education & Background: Degree in energy engineering, automation engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or a comparable STEM qualification.

Energy Intelligence: You understand DACH/EU electricity markets (day-ahead, intraday, grid services), physics and thermodynamics, and how production processes interact with energy. Experience with OPC UA, Modbus and OT networks is a plus.

AI-Native & Applied AI Engineering: You treat hallucinations as an engineering problem, have strong intuition for optimization and numerical models, and can convince even security officers of an agent's reliability.

Maker Mindset (High Agency & High Ownership): You iterate fast, treat customer feedback as your highest-priority input, and deliver results instead of waiting for instructions.

Language Skills: German at C1 level – most on-site work happens in German. If everything else fits but your German isn't C1 yet: apply anyway.

Benefits

Top-Tier Venture Capital Network: Direct access to the Point 9 and Earlybird networks – including formats for sparring, mentoring and further education.

Radical Performance Culture: Exceptional results get rewarded directly – with an uncapped OTE bonus of €5k–50k on top of your base salary. Seniority (junior to senior) is decided during the process, not by your title – don't be put off if you see yourself as more senior. Advancement is based on performance, not tenure.

Unforgettable Team Offsites (Workation): Once a year, the whole team goes on a workation. Including exclusive exchanges with our Visionary Voices (e.g. Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo, James Vincent).

Corporate Health: Full flexibility for your fitness and health with Urban Sports Club.

On-site Culture & Team Spirit: During your first year, you'll work from our office in Münster – that's where you'll get to know our system in depth and join the first deployments hands-on. After that, you'll work close to our clients in one of our industrial clusters (Rhine-Main, Rhine-Ruhr, Bavaria, Benelux).

Not a customer success job, not 9-to-5, not pure algorithm development. Send us the thing you're proudest of – and what you'd most like to build next.

Model Physics & Contracts: Storage, thermal networks, transmission, flexibility, self-consumption, minimum part loads, start-up costs – formulate what reality actually demands.

Make It Solve: Tighten big-Ms, scale models cleanly, decide where decomposition earns its complexity – and where it doesn't.

Smart Data Reduction: Time series clustering, extreme periods, segmentation and aggregation – without accuracy quietly disappearing.

Regulation into Constraints: Model grid fees, levies, tariffs, balancing power and intraday trading per country, and understand what they do to the objective function.

Prove It's Right: Test cases on real customer systems, fixtures that catch regressions, and infeasibility output an engineer can actually diagnose.

Interface & Production: Define inputs and outputs with the Product Engineers; own the runs on Kubernetes – solve time, memory and cost are your numbers.

Explain to the Customer: When a customer questions a schedule, you're the one who can say why the model chose it.

Requirements

Education & Background: Degree in mathematics, operations research, computer science, physics, energy systems engineering, business mathematics or a comparable STEM qualification.

Optimization: Deep familiarity with LP and MILP and the craft around it – formulation strength, relaxations, warm starts, solver behavior.

Practice over Papers: You've taken a model from formulation to production that others depended on.

Code & Solvers: Strong Julia – or strong Python/C++ and a real appetite to learn Julia (JuMP) fast. Hands-on with Gurobi or HiGHS, including reading logs and knowing when to reformulate instead of tuning.

Data Sense & Engineering: Comfortable with long time series, unit and sign conventions; tests, version control, code review and CI are second nature.

AI-Native: Claude Code, agents and subagents are part of your daily loop – a requirement, not a plus.

High Ownership, Low Ceremony: You take on the unclear. Energy domain knowledge helps but isn't required.

Nice to have: Stochastic or robust optimization, Benders or column generation, unit commitment, energy market modeling.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

As the Web Developer, you’ll be driving the CONROO web app forward — our central platform used daily by terminal operators, truckers, trucking companies, and internal operations teams.

Embedded in a focused cross-functional team, you'll own features end-to-end: from scoping with product through to production. The web app is becoming an increasingly foundational part of CONROO's product and is growing fast and you'll have real latitude to shape how it evolves. If you like building things that actually matter to the people using them and making consequential technical decisions without layers of approval, this is the role for you.

By 6 months

  • You significantly expand the web app’s feature set and stability.

  • As a domain owner, you have a clear vision of where to lead the codebase.

Lead Systems Engineer

We are looking for a Lead Systems Engineer to act as the Systems Technical Authority for our orbital rocket programme. You will lead the vehicle-level systems effort, maintaining a coherent technical view of the complete vehicle and leading the definition, management, and resolution of system interfaces.

Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the Systems Technical Authority for the orbital rocket programme, providing vehicle-level systems leadership and maintaining technical coherence across the complete vehicle.

  • Lead the definition, ownership, and resolution of system interfaces across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other technical departments.

  • Identify and manage interdependencies, assumptions, constraints, and cross-subsystem impacts as the vehicle design develops.

  • Use MBSE models and related system artefacts to maintain a connected view of vehicle architecture, requirements, and interfaces.

  • Lead cross-disciplinary systems discussions and reviews, bringing forward system-level trade-offs, resolving technical conflicts, and ensuring decisions are clearly recorded.

  • Coordinate technical departments around vehicle-level priorities and help keep subsystem work aligned with the needs of the overall programme.

  • Track system-level issues and interface actions through to resolution, helping establish the conditions for successful vehicle integration and launch.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong understanding of model-based systems engineering and its application to complex, multidisciplinary engineering programmes.

  • Strong understanding of rocketry and how vehicle subsystems interact across the complete system.

  • Experience leading systems engineering work, system interfaces, or cross-disciplinary technical efforts on complex engineering projects.

  • A proven track record of successfully completing engineering projects.

  • The ability to maintain a vehicle-level perspective while engaging with technical teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other disciplines.

  • Confidence facilitating technical decisions, managing competing subsystem needs, and driving interface issues toward resolution.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

As a Senior Technical Procurement Specialist – PCBs / Electronics, you are responsible for the end-to-end procurement of printed circuit boards (PCBs) through our manufacturing partners (Contract Manufacturers, CMs). You work at the interface between Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production, translating technical requirements into clear supplier packages, negotiating costs and lead times, and ensuring that the right boards are available on time and at the required quality level.

This role is ideal for someone who understands how PCBs are actually manufactured (stack-ups, materials, tolerances, DFM) and enjoys the commercial and operational aspects of bringing products to life at scale.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  •  Own PCB procurement end-to-end – from RFQ and quote analysis through PO creation, order tracking, delivery, and closure.

  •   Translate engineering needs into supplier-ready data – review BOMs, Gerbers, stackups, drawings, and specifications to ensure CMs have complete and correct information.

  • Manage contract manufacturers – build strong relationships, align on capabilities and capacity, and drive performance on cost, quality, lead time, and responsiveness, including on-site visits of contract manufacturers

  • Optimize cost and lead time – run competitive RFQs, analyze trade-offs (volume, lead time, technology level), and negotiate pricing and terms with CMs.

  • Mitigate supply and technical risks – monitor material availability (e.g. laminates, copper weights, finishes), propose alternates, and escalate issues before they become schedule slips.

  • Support NPI and engineering changes – coordinate production ramp-up, manage ECO impacts on PCB procurement, and ensure smooth transitions from prototype to volume.

  • Ensure quality and compliance – work closely with QA/engineering to address nonconformances, track supplier performance, and ensure boards meet required standards (e.g. IPC, customer specs).

  • Keep everything organized and visible – maintain accurate data in ERP/MRP and tracking tools, provide clear status updates, and keep stakeholders aligned on dates and risks.


What you bring to the team:

  • Technical background in electronics or PCBs – ability to read schematics, BOMs, and Gerber/ODB++ files; familiarity with PCB stackups, materials, finishes, and manufacturing constraints.

  • Experience in electronics/PCB procurement or supply chain – ideally working directly with PCB fabs and/or PCB assembly contract manufacturers.

  • Comfortable working with engineers – you can discuss layer counts, impedance, controlled tolerances, and DFM/DFT topics and translate that into supplier requirements.

  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills – able to compare quotes, build cost breakdowns, negotiate pricing and MOQs, and structure win–win agreements.

data.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Operational Excellence:

  • Oversee event budget management, ensuring accurate cost calculations, approvals, and final invoicing.

  • Ensure the team adheres to company service standards and hospitality protocols at all times.
  • Lead weekly event meetings and Programme Execution Order (PEO) discussions, ensuring alignment across all stakeholders.

Skills & Experience

Essential:

  • Extensive experience in event planning and production, with a strong background in physical, hybrid, and virtual event formats.

  • Excellent client relationship management and communication skills.
  • Knowledge of AV production, catering logistics, and event operations.
  • Proficiency in event management software and project management tools.
  • 2 years experience in large-scale corporate event planning.

Desirable:

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Data & Science Org

At Deliveroo we have an outstanding data science organisation, with a mission to enable the highest quality human and machine decision-making. We work throughout the company - in product, business and platform teams - using analysis, experimentation, causal inference and machine learning techniques. We are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Deliveroo.

Data Scientists at Deliveroo report into our data science management team, and we have a highly active data science community, with guest lecturers, study groups, mentorship programmes, a robust technical review process, and plenty of opportunities to learn new things. Data Scientists can equally progress as technical leads (individual contributors) and as people managers.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science, many are not. We celebrate difference and have a dedicated data science diversity committee.

As an Economist at Deliveroo you will help scale our business and improve the experience for restaurants, riders, and eaters. Using experimental or observational data, you will get to help answer questions like:

  • Which markets/cities should we enter next?

  • How can we incentivise good rider behaviour?

  • What is the business impact of exclusive deals we have with restaurants?

  • Can the Delivery food market sustain multiple players?

  • What are the trade-offs we face when choosing between growth and profitability? How should we decide between them?

  • What is the optimum selection and variety of restaurants?

  • What impact do online reviews have?

  • How will a change in the user interface affect customer choice behaviour?

The work you will do will have a direct, measurable impact on the bottom line of the company.

Requirements:

  • Masters Degree or PhD in Economics or Econometrics (preferred)

  • Always curious and willing to learn new skills

  • A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business-relevant economic problems

  • A critical thinker with very strong attention to detail

  • Proficiency with analytical tools like R/Python and familiarity with SQL

  • Ideally industry experience since the completion of your academic career

  • Excellent people skills — you'll be meeting with stakeholders to translate business needs into economic problems

At Deliveroo these are just some of the tough problems we are solving - and there is no challenge that cannot be yours. The scope for growth and personal impact is enormous.

Why Deliveroo
Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. And we’re a long way from done!

LEGAL & COMPLIANCE @ CARWOW

Our fantastic legal team has been compared to a set of high-performance tyres, enabling Carwow to drive and corner at high speeds whilst keeping Carwow firmly on the road in all conditions. As the business pushes forward with bold ambitions, the legal team’s purpose is clear: to drive Carwow’s growth with integrity and confidence – and that’s where you come in!

YOUR MISSION

We are a platform that sits right in the middle between consumers and OEMs/Dealers in the car-changing journey. Datasits at the heart of everything we do and we want to commercialise it responsibly.

As Senior Privacy Counsel, you will be Carwow’s dedicated in-house privacy lawyer and operational privacy lead, playing a pivotal role in enabling the business to grow and scale at pace with integrity. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your career in a complex, high-growth and data-thirsty marketplace business.

We are looking for a Senior Privacy Counsel who wants to do more than provide legal advice from the sidelines. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing legal function as our first dedicated in-house privacy hire, taking ownership of the day-to-day privacy programme while acting as a senior legal and strategic advisor to the business as it sharpens its privacy governance programme and steers towards further growth and an exit.

We are not at “Day Zero”. We currently have an external DPO, established policies, templates, a RoPA and a risk register.

We need a tech-fluent privacy lawyer who is equally comfortable advising and doing: someone who can interpret complex legal requirements, exercise sound legal judgement and provide pragmatic advice, but who will also roll up their sleeves and build, operate and continuously improve the mechanisms that make privacy work in practice.

You will have the mandate to lift the lid on our technology stack, validate our data flows, identify legal and operational privacy risks and work directly with our Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and commercial teams to keep the business safe and moving fast.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Privacy governance and framework development: Own, develop and maintain Carwow’s enterprise privacy governance framework, encompassing internal policies, ROPAs, privacy notices, risk registers, retention schedules and associated controls. Interpret applicable legal requirements and ensure our documentation and processes reflect the reality of Carwow’s technology stack and processing activities, leading remediation where discrepancies or risks are identified.

  • Legal advice and business partnering: Act as Carwow’s principal in-house legal advisor on privacy and data protection matters. Develop strong business partnering relationships across Marketing, Media, Product, Engineering, Data and other parts of the business, providing pragmatic, risk-based legal advice that enables commercial objectives while appropriately managing privacy risk. Provide advice to senior management and support the General Counsel in updating the Company’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives as needed.

  • Culture & Training: Build a strong internal perception of privacy as a “trust builder”. Design and deliver role-specific training that is engaging, commercially relevant and free of unnecessary legal jargon, helping teams understand both their legal obligations and how to apply them in practice.

  • Breach response: Lead the privacy aspects of data breach and incident response, working cross-functionally to investigate incidents, assess legal and regulatory risk, determine notification obligations and oversee remediation. Liaise with the external DPO, regulators and other relevant stakeholders as appropriate.

  • DPAs, DSAs and data contracting: Draft, review and negotiate DPAs, DSAs and other data protection provisions and agreements arising from commercial arrangements. Provide practical legal advice on controller/processor relationships, data sharing, international transfers and related privacy risks.

  • DSARs and individual rights: Own and continuously improve Carwow’s processes for responding to data subject rights requests, ensuring requests can be handled lawfully, efficiently and with minimal disruption to the business. Provide legal guidance on complex or sensitive requests where required.

  • Retail Media and Ad Tech: Provide legal and operational privacy support on new commercial propositions looking to leverage Carwow’s data for third-party audience targeting, segmentation and advertising. Advise on the appropriate use of personal data, profiling, consent and data-sharing structures and help design commercially workable and legally robust mechanisms for using and sharing data.

  • Product, Data and Technology: Work closely with Data & Insights, IT, Engineering and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle to embed Privacy by Design. Lead or support privacy assessments, identify legal and operational risks in new products and processing activities, and translate complex technical data flows into clear, risk-based advice for the General Counsel, Executives and wider business.

  • Operationalise Compliance: Own and operate core privacy compliance processes, including DPIAs, LIAs and data-sharing assessments. Look continuously for opportunities to integrate these into existing business workflows, with an eye on making compliance proportionate, scalable and automated wherever possible.

  • Regulatory developments: Monitor and interpret relevant developments in privacy, data protection, digital regulation and related areas, assess their impact on Carwow and translate new legal requirements into practical changes to products, policies, controls and business processes.

  • Corporate work: Provide privacy legal support on M&A, funding and other corporate transactions, including conducting privacy due diligence, identifying material risks and supporting remediation and integration activity.

  • AI and emerging technology: Advise on the privacy implications of AI and emerging technologies adopted or developed across the business, while supporting the development of practical governance mechanisms that allow Carwow to innovate responsibly.

  • Multi-jurisdictional: Support Carwow’s businesses across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal, advising on relevant local and European privacy requirements and working with external counsel where specialist local advice is required.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • A qualified lawyer, admitted to practise in England & Wales or another relevant UK or European jurisdiction, with significant experience advising on privacy and data protection matters.

  • Significant experience working in-house, balancing legal and regulatory requirements with commercial objectives and operating as a trusted advisor to the business.

  • Strong working knowledge of UK and European data protection law, with the ability to interpret legislation, regulatory guidance and emerging issues and translate them into clear, practical and commercially workable advice.

  • Experience not only providing privacy legal advice but also building, operating or materially contributing to a privacy programme, including areas such as DPIAs, RoPAs, privacy notices, data rights, retention, incident response and privacy governance.

  • The ability and willingness to work autonomously as Carwow’s principal in-house privacy specialist, moving comfortably between complex legal analysis and hands-on operational delivery.

  • Passionate about the intersection of AI and privacy, with an interest in how to safeguard the organisation during technology adoption while also leveraging AI to enhance and automate privacy operations.

  • A team player with a growth mindset, high EQ and low ego, excited to be part of a scale-up, high-growth company where every day brings new challenges and opportunities.

  • To be able to work in a fast-paced environment with teams that move and pivot quickly.

  • Fluency in English and strong written and verbal communication skills, together with a proactive, persuasive and adaptable manner.

  • Driven to ensure the Legal & Compliance Team is viewed as a genuine partner to the business, with the initiative and credibility to build relationships across functions and at senior levels.

BONUS POINTS

What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.


A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.


Does this sound like you?
Flagstone is entering a pivotal phase for its website – a full redesign and relaunch, running alongside a parallel Brand refresh. We're looking for a senior website and digital experience leader to own this as a strategic programme, and to act as the Squad Lead for the WWW (website) Squad, leading our cross-functional team, spanning Product, UX, Data, Engineering & Digital Marketing.

Sitting within our Product function, you'll set the direction and commercial strategy for the site, sequence the programme, and coordinate contributors across Brand, Marketing, Growth/Creative, Data, and Tech – while giving your team the space to execute against a clear plan. You've owned a public website as a commercial and brand-critical asset before, and you'll need minimal supervision on process: you're trusted to run the show, escalating only what genuinely needs senior leadership's input rather than day-to-day noise.

You might currently hold a title such as Head of Website, Head of Web Experience, Head of Conversion Rate Optimisation, or Digital Product Marketing Lead. What matters most is that you've owned a website end-to-end as a revenue and brand-driving channel, with a strong track record in CRO, experimentation, and digital experience at scale.


What you’ll do:

  • Own the strategy, commercial roadmap and outcomes for the website redesign and relaunch, working hand-in-hand with the Brand team so the two workstreams land as one coherent outcome.

  • Lead the cross-functional Website squad – setting priorities, unblocking the team, and holding the group (product, UX, data, engineering, digital marketing) to a shared plan.

  • Design and run the end-to-end programme: sequencing dependencies across product, marketing, creative, data, and engineering, and keeping it on track without needing to escalate routine issues upward.

  • Define the strategic direction for site structure, customer journeys, and conversion approach, translating business goals into a clear plan the team can execute against.

  • Represent the website programme to senior stakeholders – bringing clarity and options, not problems, to conversations with the Senior Leadership Team.

  • Set the standards and guardrails for how experimentation, CRO, and iterative. improvement will work post-relaunch, handing over a structured, sustainable operating model.

  • Manage risk and trade-offs across the programme – commercial, technical, brand, and customer experience – and make the calls needed to keep momentum.

  • Build strong working relationships with Brand, Marketing, UX, Engineering, and third-party partners/agencies, ensuring the programme benefits from – rather than competes with – parallel initiatives.

  • Coach and line manage Product managers within the WWW squad to deliver high-quality outcomes.

What you’ll bring:

  • Proven experience owning a public-facing website as a commercial and brand asset – ideally as a Head of Website, Head of Web Experience, Head of CRO, or equivalent digital/marketing leadership title – through a redesign or relaunch from strategy through to delivery.

  • Deep experience with conversion rate optimisation, experimentation, and website analytics, with the judgement to know how much to own directly versus delegate.

  • Strong data analytics skills, with hands-on experience using product analytics tools (ideally Heap or similar) to inform decisions and track programme impact.

  • Experience leading a genuinely cross-functional team (product, UX, data, engineering, marketing), ideally in a scale-up or fast-moving environment.

  • A track record of running complex, multi-stream programmes of work with minimal oversight – comfortable owning ambiguity and making decisions.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to and managing expectations of senior leadership.

  • A strategic mindset paired with enough tactical fluency to know when to step in and when to trust your team.

  • Familiarity with CMS platforms and working with third-party agencies and/or engineering teams to deliver change.

  • Strong written and verbal communication – you can turn a strategic vision into a plan others can execute against.

Nice to haves

  • Experience running a redesign alongside a parallel brand or rebrand workstream.

  • Background in financial services or fintech, particularly regulated environments.

  • Familiarity with agile ways of working and cross-functional delivery models.

  • Experience with tools such as VWO, Umbraco, or similar CMS/experimentation platforms.

 

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Around the World scheme - 3 months work from anywhere scheme (some exclusions do apply)

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

All are welcome.

You won't just recruit the way it's always been done. We want someone who brings fresh thinking, uses AI and a modern ATS to work smarter, and helps shape how Talent works at Legend as we grow. For the right person, this role has room to grow into something bigger.

Deliver at pace
•    Run a live portfolio of 10+ roles, closing at least four a month without lowering the hiring bar.

Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

About Neko Health

Neko Health is a Swedish healthcare technology company founded in 2018 by Hjalmar Nilsonne and Daniel Ek. Our mission is to redesign healthcare by shifting the focus from reactive treatment to proactive and preventive care.

We are building a new kind of healthcare experience designed to help people stay ahead of their health. By combining medical expertise with breakthrough technology, we make it possible to quickly and non-invasively gather a broad picture of a person's health and deliver clear insights within minutes.

Headquartered in Stockholm and New York, Neko Health offers the Neko Body Scan experience across Europe and the US, supported by a growing team of people working to transform how healthcare is delivered.

Why this role exists

Legal, Finance and People are what let Neko operate, hire and stay compliant as it scales, and Product & Technology is the largest, most complex function at HQ. These aren't the same kind of problem. Each function sits at a different stage of maturity, and this role isn't about pulling them into one shape. It's about moving fluidly between genuinely different disciplines, bringing the right kind of people practice to each, rather than defaulting to a single playbook.

This is one of the most senior People roles at HQ outside the Global People Lead itself. It suits a senior level HR operator who's genuinely comfortable holding several different kinds of problem at once, and who brings real depth in organisational design, workforce planning, strategy and culture, genuine command of each rather than surface-level familiarity.

What you'll do

Own the people agenda across Corporate Functions and partners with the Global People lead on parts of the Product & Tech organisation

  • Lead workforce planning and organisational design across Legal, Finance, People, (and support to parts of the Product & Technology teams) role clarity, resourcing decisions and structural recommendations tailored to each function's stage

  • Meet each function on its own terms, building where a function is still finding its shape, optimising where it's stable, rather than applying one approach everywhere

  • Build genuine partnership with the leaders who run each of these teams, calibrating the relationship to what each one needs

Be the strategic partner to senior leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner across Legal, Finance, People and some of the Product & Technology teams, translating business strategy into people priorities, programmes and operating plans for each function

  • Coach and challenge leaders on the decisions that shape the organisation they'll be running next year, thinking a step ahead of today's priorities

  • Bring sound judgement and discretion to the most sensitive people matters across all four functions

Champion Neko's culture and Vitals

  • Partner with leaders across Legal, Finance, People and parts of the Product & Technology to embed Neko's cultural Vitals into how their teams actually operate, day to day

  • Help leaders translate the Vitals into practical behaviours and decisions across genuinely different functions

  • Build the rituals and feedback loops that keep culture genuinely lived as each function matures at its own pace

Drive talent management across Corporate Functions and Product & Tech

  • Working in partnership with the Growth & Engagement team to drive leadership development, performance and engagement for the leadership population across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology

  • Advise on compensation, mobility and promotions in partnership with Reward & Enablement, ensuring internal equity and market competitiveness across genuinely different functions

Lead change and manage risk

  • Lead and sponsor change initiatives that affect structure or operating model in any of these functions, owning scope, timeline, stakeholder engagement and change readiness from start to finish

  • Manage employee relations matters across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology, working directly with Legal colleagues and specialist counsel to resolve issues with discretion and confidentiality

  • Spot risk early, whether that's capacity strain in Legal or Finance, or Product & Technology's pace outstripping its structure

Drive organisational design and workforce planning

  • Use workforce and org data to shape decisions ahead of need

  • Deliver people analytics and actionable insights that turn data into clear, decision-ready recommendations

  • Put data and AI to work in how the people agenda runs day to day, sharper decisions, less manual effort

Bring the right practice to functions at different stages

  • Recognise that Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology each need different structures, rhythms and support, and build accordingly

  • Turn central People programmes into practice that fits each function's actual culture and maturity

  • Experience evaluating how AI informs talent decisions and org design, bringing the judgement to design with AI as a genuine participant in how roles and structures should look, actively shaping the work itself.

What you bring

  • Deep, hands-on experience across organisational design, workforce planning, people strategy and culture, genuine depth in all four, built through direct ownership rather than generalist HRBP exposure

  • 10+ years in senior HR Business Partner, People Partner, or People/HR leadership roles, including ownership of the people agenda across genuinely different functions at Director level or above

  • Experience owning leadership development and performance calibration outcomes for a senior leadership population

  • A track record of personally leading change initiatives end to end: scope, timeline, and stakeholder engagement

  • A genuine passion for culture and values, with experience helping leaders embed them into how their teams actually work

  • A track record of partnering with and influencing senior functional leaders on complex, high-stakes organisational decisions, operating with genuine autonomy as an independent decision-maker

  • Comfort holding functions at very different stages of maturity at once, adapting approach rather than applying one framework to all

  • Fluent with people data and actively using AI in your own work

  • Working knowledge of employment law relevant to Neko's HQ locations, with the judgement to know when to bring in specialist expertise

About Titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market-facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process.

Hiring Process

Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews, culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement

Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application.

Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We’re looking for an experienced Ultrasound sonographer to join our multidisciplinary team in London on a 12 month fixed term contract and help to take ultrasounds as part of a clinical research study.

This is a key role focused on delivering high-quality, independent assessments. You’ll perform and interpret ultrasound scans of adult women who are receiving a breast ultrasound as part of a clinical study. You will work in conjunction with the principal investigator of the study to ensure that assessments and reports are of research-grade quality. This is a fixed term role that lasts for the duration of the study and is based at our clinics in London.

What You’ll Deliver

  • Perform high-quality diagnostic ultrasound examinations in line with clinical guidelines and best practices with focus on breast ultrasound

  • Pass on the study-specific acquisition and interpretation qualification task before performing study scans, with certificate filed in the investigational site file.

  • Independently interpret and report ultrasound findings, ensuring timely delivery of results that are uploaded to a standardised electronic case report form.

  • Collaborate with our multidisciplinary research team to help deliver Neko’s clinical trial focused on better understanding risks of breast cancer.

  • Adherence to the study acquisition SOP

  • Equipment QA maintenance logged on-site. Liaise directly with the study PI and research team where needed.

Minimum Requirements

  • HCPC-registered diagnostic radiographer (or other HCPC-/NMC-registered healthcare professional), holding a CASE-accredited postgraduate qualification in breast ultrasound (PgCert / PgDip / MSc, or a named CASE-accredited breast ultrasound module.

  • Documented, current breast ultrasound practice, with a minimum of two years’ full-time-equivalent breast scanning.

  • Advanced radiographic experience of reporting autonomously within the NHS Breast Screening Programme (NHSBSP) or an equivalent quality-assurance framework.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly to study participants.

  • Commitment to maintaining high clinical standards and engaging in ongoing professional development.

Preferred

  • Experience with previous ultrasound scanning as part of clinical trials

  • Experience with shear-wave elastography acquisition and reporting.

  • Experience with Philips US machines, and decision support software

  • Familiarity with data entry as part of clinical research studies.
