Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Opportunity

We are at an inflection point in our journey. Our platform now serves tens of thousands of learners, demand for AI skills is accelerating, and we are investing seriously in the product and technology that will take us to the next stage of scale. This is a role for someone who wants to build the product that gets more people into transformative learning, and upskill people with critical data and AI skills faster.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Prescribe: the product that helps a prospective learner find the right programme for their skills and their employer's goals, then takes them to a confident commitment and a successful start. You will be the strategic counterpart to a Senior Engineering Manager, working alongside design and data, and closely with our go-to-market and fulfilment teams.

Growth at Multiverse means getting more people from first interest to a confident start, and it is a product problem, not a marketing problem. You will own the conversion metrics, set the strategy, run the experiments, and drive the outcomes. AI will drive much of the improvement, and you will decide where it helps.

As a Lead, you will work regularly with the most senior leaders across the company. You will report to the Single Threaded Leader for Diagnose & Prescribe and will not manage other product managers. The role is based in London, hybrid, three days a week in the office.

What You'll Own

AI-native product experiences

  • Shape new conversational, AI-first experiences that help learners and customers understand the best programme for their skills and career development.

  • Decide where AI genuinely improves a match and where it only adds noise, and build the evaluation and guardrails that keep it trustworthy in front of real users.

  • Turn learner and customer behaviour into product direction.

Prescription and eligibility

  • Own the logic that connects a learner's skills to a programme and to a customer's levy funding, where mistakes carry a real financial and regulatory cost.

  • Work with Legal, Compliance and Fulfilment to make eligibility and compliance rules configurable and explainable, so business owners can change them without a rebuild.

  • Make every recommendation something a learner and a customer can understand and challenge.

Recommendation, commitment and finalisation

  • Own the journey from recommendation to a learner committing and starting.

  • Identify high-leverage drop-off points and own the experimentation roadmap.

  • Design product interventions that adapt to learner needs and behaviour and shorten the time to a confident start.

  • Collaborate with GTM, Operations and Data teams to improve attribution and the quality of what enters the funnel.

Metrics and experimentation

  • Own conversion from prospect to committed learner, with retention and programme fit as the guardrails.

  • Champion a culture of hypothesis-led, structured experimentation.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Co-own the strategy and roadmap with your Senior Engineering Manager, with disagreement surfaced early and alignment as your shared deliverable.

  • Involve GTM, Fulfilment and Support before changes ship. They run what we build, so know their biggest pain points.

  • Author the narratives the group needs, from the press release and FAQ (PRFAQ) for your area to the sales-facing briefing for a launch.

  • Represent Prescribe in roadmap conversations with senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

The best candidates will have owned a growth-critical product before, ideally in a B2B or ideally a B2B2C context. You should have hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features and the ability to navigate complexity without losing sight of the learner.

Must-have experience:

  • Substantial experience as a PM with a track record of improving measurable growth metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, automation).

  • Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards.

  • Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments.

  • Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies.

  • Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts.

  • Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content.

  • AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies.

Strong signals we look for:

  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) in a B2B context.

  • Experience designing personalisation systems, including data models and trigger logic.

  • Previous work in a company that has scaled from hundreds to thousands of users.

  • A point of view on where AI genuinely improves outcomes versus creating noise.

  • A bonus if you've done this in a regulated environment, such as funding, eligibility or compliance-heavy products. Knowledge of UK apprenticeships and the levy is an additional plus.

How you work:

  • Solve for Customer Value: You're direct about data, even when it challenges existing priorities.

  • Drivers, Not Passengers: You think in systems, take completion seriously, and raise bad news as quickly as good.

  • Be Decisive, Even in Ambiguity: You're comfortable with ambiguity and define structure in new spaces.

  • AI to Deliver Outcomes: You have a bias for action (ship, measure, iterate) and ask "how would AI help do this?" before scoping the work.

Not for you if:

This role won't fit if you'd rather write specs than stay close to the data, the design, and the customer. It also won't fit if you see AI as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a product team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out.

  • Help maintain badge readers, cameras, and other office technology by identifying faults and coordinating fixes under established processes. Security owns access policy and monitoring.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have 3+ years of hands-on IT support, workplace technology, desktop support, or similar experience, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, startup environment. You assess what’s urgent, shift focus as priorities change, and follow through on the work that matters most. You set a high bar for delivery while keeping colleagues informed along the way.

  • You're comfortable following security and access procedures, handling employee information carefully, and escalating requests that need approval.

  • You're curious, willing to learn, and quick to act. You notice recurring problems and suggest practical improvements.

  • You enjoy being present in the office. This role is onsite in London five days a week, helping colleagues and keeping the space working.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with meeting-room AV and conferencing tools such as Zoom Rooms or Neat.

  • Exposure to office networking or physical-security hardware, such as Meraki, badge readers, or Verkada.

You don't need experience with every tool listed. Strong troubleshooting, dependable follow-through, and a willingness to learn matter most.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The role

Every parcel through our sort centres is handled by an operative. At peak, we need to hire up to 600 of them a week.

As Operations Manager, Operative Acquisition you'll own operative supply across our sortation sites: enough suitable, trained, compliant and active operatives to fill every shift. You'll build the funnel, reporting and automation that make supply repeatable rather than manual, and keep it ahead of demand as volume rises.

Volumes rise sharply into November and December. Supply, not demand, will be the constraint. This role exists to make sure it isn't.

You'll be the single owner of the operative funnel, working across acquisition (including paid channels), Live Operations, our site teams, and Product and Engineering, who build the integrations the funnel runs on. You'll write SQL, ship automation, and spend time at our sort centres seeing how new starters actually land.

What you'll do

  • Own the operative funnel end to end, from applicant attraction through qualification, training, activation and retention

  • Keep applicant supply ahead of site demand, forecasting how many applicants, training places and sessions are needed and directing spend where gaps exist

  • Improve qualification and compliance, owning Right to Work/KYC and working with Product and Engineering to reduce drop-off and speed up the process

  • Optimise training capacity and waitlists, making sure sessions are filled and candidates stay engaged

  • Get new starters onto shift quickly, supporting activation, shift fill, communications and low-fill processes

  • Reduce cancellations, no-shows and inactivity, using the root causes to improve communications, processes and policies

  • Own operative communications and compliance processes, including waitlist messaging, suspensions, strikes and shift-booking comms

  • Build clear funnel reporting and alerts, tracking volumes, conversion, time to hire and drop-off by site to identify issues early

Who Will Thrive in this role?

  • A growth or operations background. You treat supply as a daily number and act the same day it slips

  • Confident in SQL (BigQuery or similar). You build dashboards from raw data, not static trackers

  • Experience running a high-volume hiring or onboarding funnel, ideally for a frontline workforce

  • Comfortable with paid acquisition, Google Ads or similar, enough to read performance and brief changes when a site runs short

  • Hands-on with automation, setting up triggers for invitations, comms and alerts, and quick to get confident in a new ATS or scheduling system

  • A working understanding of Right to Work checks, enough to see how checks and re-checks affect the funnel and operative status. Legal owns the detail, but this can't be a blank

  • Clear writing. You can write processes, requirements and comms that other teams rely on

Desirable

  • Experience onboarding couriers or drivers at a carrier or delivery platform

  • Experience working with Product and Engineering on integrations or APIs

  • Experience with predictive or candidate-quality modelling

  • Experience planning for peak or seasonal demand

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Hardware of your choice

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more)

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

Seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As an early employee, you’ll play a meaningful role in defining and building our culture. Get in on the ground floor. We’re a small but well-funded team that just raised a substantial round – joining now comes with limited risk and unlimited upside.

Culture is one of the most important things at TENEX.AI—explore our culture deck at culture.tenex.ai to witness how we embody it, prioritizing the irreplaceable collaboration and community of in-person work.

The Opportunity

This is a build role for an experienced operator who wants ownership, not a seat in an established machine. As the first Customer Success hire in EMEA, you will be both the senior customer-facing face of TENEX in the region and the person who builds the CS team beneath you. Early on you will carry a small book of strategic accounts yourself; over time you will shift from doing the work to hiring, coaching, and scaling a team that does.

You will be the day-to-day CS partner to our EMEA commercial leadership, while staying tightly connected to our global CS motion, framework, and quality bar. If you want to shape how customer success is delivered across a region from a blank page — and be measured on real retention and expansion outcomes — this is that role.

What You Will Do

  • Own the customer relationship (player): Personally own named strategic EMEA accounts as the senior CS point of contact, especially in the first ~90 days. Drive onboarding, adoption, value realization, and executive alignment for MDR engagements — the moments where CISOs form their durable impression of TENEX. Serve as the in-region escalation point and trusted advisor for security leaders across EMEA.

  • Build and lead the team (coach): Hire, onboard, and develop the EMEA CSM team, scaling the function from one (you) to a multi-person pod as the business grows. Run interview loops, build a bench in-region and in-time-zone, and set the local operating rhythm (QBRs, health reviews, escalation paths) in lockstep with the global CS framework.

  • Partner across the business: Act as the day-to-day CS partner to EMEA commercial leadership, contributing to account strategy, expansion planning, and regional go-to-market. Represent the voice of the EMEA customer back into global CS, product, and delivery. Partner with Project Management on onboarding delivery to protect time-to-value in-region.

  • Own the outcomes: Carry regional accountability for the metrics that matter: gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), and time-to-value. Translate TENEX's data-residency and compliance posture into clear, confident onboarding conversations with EMEA customers.

What You Bring

  • Deep background in MDR, managed security services, or a comparable high-touch B2B managed-services / SaaS environment.

Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

Over 200,000 businesses run on DeepL, and their stories are the most persuasive asset we have. This role puts them front and centre across brand, demand and growth. Buyers evaluating Language AI trust other buyers. We're building the proof that puts customer stories in front of them at scale.

You'll sit in Product Marketing, report to the VP, and work at pace with Field, Brand, Digital, Comms and PR.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Amplify our customers’ success: Surface the stories our customers are already telling within support tickets, sales nominations, deal wins and win-loss interviews, and choose the few that deserve to become full stories. Ship marquee stories (blue-chip, video, event-ready), named case studies and quantified proof points that show DeepL's AI doing real work in real businesses.

  • Put our customers on the world stage: Press interviews, webinars, keynotes and our Customer Advisory Board advocacy track. You recommend who speaks, agree the narrative with them in advance, and make each appearance count beyond the day itself..

  • Put a real customer in front of every buyer: Sales and Customer Success come to you when a deal needs a reference. You'll know which customers will speak, what they'll speak about, and how recently each was asked. Sales enablement builds the seller tools - you supply the customers and the proof that goes inside them.

  • Share stories while they still matter: Stories work hardest published alongside a launch, event or campaign they belong to. You own the run from interview to live asset, including the legal and brand engagement, and keep customer permissions current so nothing sits waiting.

 

Measures of success (first 12 months)

  • New marquee stories the field, brand and events teams all pull from.

  • Named case studies covering every region, product lines and priority verticals

  • Reference requests resolved within the agreed turnaround time

  • Stories publishing in the same window as the launch or event they belong to

  • Clear evidence that deals using a customer reference close at a better rate

 

Qualities we look for

  • Proven success in B2B marketing, over many years: customer marketing, content, comms or advocacy, with a track record of stories that engaged buyers and moved deals

  • Bias for action: you're a self-starter who clears your own hurdles. You do not wait for a brief

  • Automate before you escalate: when a step is slow, your instinct is to build a way round it. AI is already in your workflow, not on your list of things to try.

  • Storytelling: genuine curiosity about a customer's business problem, and the instinct to find the narrative inside it

  • Customer-facing polish: comfortable with customers from first discovery call through to launch

  • Strategic judgement: you can map advocacy output to our priorities and back the stories that serve them

  • Operational rigour: you have built the production, approvals and permissions process - and made it fast

 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JW2

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Our Company
 

ION is the world’s most progressive FinTech company providing pioneering software and consultancy services to customers around the globe. We serve large financial institutions, trading firms, central banks, and corporations. We are committed to automating processes that positively impact on our customers’ work and provide insights to enable more informed decision making. We provide software and data to our customers to simplify complex processes and digitize their businesses. Our products and services help the world's leading organizations do more, in a better and simpler way, than ever before. 

ION software underpins the global fixed income, foreign exchange, and derivatives markets, powers the world’s central banks, and enables the automation of workflows across critical treasury and commodities operations for thousands of companies worldwide. ION data and analytics are the golden source for M&A, equity, and leverage finance bankers worldwide. With a dynamic team of 13,000+ employees, 40+ global offices, and 5,000+ customers worldwide, ION provides an unparalleled career experience for those who share our passion for growth and technology evolution.

 
ION Group consists of the following divisions:
 
  • ION Analytics: Provider of investment banking M&A, equity and debt data, analytics, and content.
  • ION Corporates: Provider for the digital corporation, enabling automation of workflows across critical treasury and commodities operations.
  • ION Markets: Provider of trading automation, analytics, and infrastructure to the global financial markets.
  • ION Core Banking: Provider of core banking and financial software for financial institutions in Italy and internationally.
  • ION Insight Score: Provider of credit information and credit management in Italy.
  • ION Risk Metrics: Provider of credit servicing and asset management in Italy. 
 
Our Programme
 
Our Leadership Development Program (LDP) is a foundational global initiative focused on developing talent for ION’s growing operations around the world. The program provides an opportunity for outstanding university graduates to start a career in a dynamic and fast paced global FinTech firm.
 
Analysts will spend the first 3 years of their career in 3 unique, 12-month rotations gaining experience across the product lifecycle. At the end of their 3 rotations analysts will transition to a deeper dive in one area of ION. 
 
 
What you'll do

In the role of Software Developer, you will develop products for our global customers including Tier 1 banks and Fortune 100 corporations. You will be part of an Agile team, who are responsible for end-to-end product development, including: 

  • Analyzing business requirements and product solutioning. 

  • Architecture and designs using the latest principles and patterns in software engineering. 

  • Coding, testing, and continuous integration of solutions using the latest and upcoming technologies. 

 
Your Contribution

  • Build innovative products and solutions that: 

    • Reduce business process complexity.
    • Increase organizational efficiency through automation.
    • Liberate people from performing repetitive manual tasks.
    • Help ION’s clients gain a competitive advantage by using our products. 

  • Resolve complex technical and business issues and communicate effectively to Internal teams and ION clients. 

  • Automate complex business workflows and processes and make a positive impact to client businesses. 

 
Basic Qualifications

  • 2027 graduation. 

  • 2:1 or above. 

  • Bachelor’s, or Master’s, in Computer Science or related STEM disciplines, such as Data Science, or Quantitative Finance, with experience in hands-on programming required. 

  • Authorization to work in selected countries without restriction or need for sponsorship. 

  • Demonstrated interest in finance and/or technology, ideally including work experience. 

  • Passion for learning, self-improvement, and a questioning and challenging mindset. 

  • Motivated self-starter who is proactive, enthusiastic, and passionate about what they do. 

  • Strong problem-solving capabilities and the desire to understand the “why” behind each problem.

 
How you'll grow
 

Our 36-month Leadership Development Program (LDP) allows you to rotate through different areas of the product lifecycle. You will work closely with ION product teams, and clients, and grow, gaining: 

  • Deep knowledge in:

    • Diverse set of technologies, development methodologies, and processes required to build complex mission-critical systems using distributed architectures.

    • Financial domain to build world class products. 

  • E2E Software Product Development Lifecycle. 

  • A mastery of foundational technologies, keeping on top of constant technological evolution through your work with subject matter experts. 

  • Personality traits in an Imaginative and Positive culture:

    • Passionate. 

    • Expressive.

    • Intelligent. 

  • Exposure to: 

    • Product Management. 

    • Client Services. 

    • Support. 

    • Deployment. 

Application process

Applicants that submit successful online applications will be required to complete an assessment within 4 days of receiving the test link.

Successful applicants will subsequently be invited to a video interview.

The final part of the process is an assessment day at our London office, consisting of interviews, a case study and a group exercise.

We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as you are ready because initial video interviews can occur prior to the application period closing.

We aim to notify you of your application status approximately one or months after we receive your application.

Final assessment day will be confirmed later.

An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

data.description:
Ready to automate, innovate and make a real impact? 

Do you want to build reliable, scalable systems that make a real difference to millions of people? Do you want to work at a certified B Corp with an inclusive and learning culture as part of a diverse team of great people? 
 
If so, Opencast could be the place for you. We’re a growing tech consultancy that creates user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in government, healthcare and purpose-driven businesses. Working in DevOps, you’ll build and maintain the systems that let teams respond quickly to needs. You’ll work on high-impact projects, helping to build reliable, scalable systems. We align work to industry-recognised roles such as Build & Release Engineer (BRE), Platform Engineer (PLE) or Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) and, where needed, to more specialised areas such as security, cloud hosting, infrastructure or networking. 
 

The Role

At Opencast, we love to keep things simple, and we love automation. 
 
It’s not the same as your standard DevOps Consultant job. Depending on your client’s needs, you’ll take on a range of roles. These will include: 
  • Taking the lead on responding to outages, triaging issues, balancing stakeholder priorities/concerns, and keeping communication channels open with all parties. 
  • Developing, and implementing continuous deployment solutions that help our clients to deliver software faster and more efficiently. 
  • Collaborating with our clients to understand their ways of working and will have an enthusiasm to learn new tools and technologies as needed. 
  • Contributing within Opencast communities.
  • Ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client. 
We care about building things right. We believe in good DevOps practices and keeping things simple. We want to support you as much as we can on interiorising our approach to DevOps engineering and you supporting others. 
 
We are proud consultants who combine our own experience and approach with our company values. 
 
We are comfortable with new tech. We are empowered, cloud native, vendor agnostic DevOps engineers. We are empathetic, patient and care about quality. 
 
We know when to pick our battles and how to manage expectations. We are humble, inclusive team players that listen and collaborate, with zero egos! 
 
We’re always willing to teach and help others (inside or outside of our team). And we’re always willing to learn. 
 
It’s a varied job that keeps you super technical and excited. 
 

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients. 

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements. 

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying. 

We’re looking to welcome new team members for multiple roles from June 2026 onward. If you’re interested in joining Opencast, we’d encourage you to apply. 

Essential experience

To succeed in this role, you'll have experience working within DevOps and be able to demonstrate, with tangible examples, that you can: 

  • Create, modify, and maintain complex CI/CD pipelines.

  • Create dashboards and visualisations for application performance that proactively identify and address potential problems before they occur.

  • Use automated testing to detect security issues/vulnerabilities in application and/or infrastructure code, thereby detecting issues before it reaches production (aka Shift-Left).

  • Strong experience in operating and maintaining services primarily in any of the BIG three public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, and GCP).

Essential consulting skills 

In addition to DevOps skills, there are essential core skills you need to be an Opencast consultant. You'll need to demonstrate how you: 
  • Contribute to improving ways of working and driving continuous improvements within your teams. 
  • Share knowledge and best practice with fellow consultants, including proactively engaging in client and Opencast communities of practice. 
  • Positively challenge decisions or solutions you don't agree with, striving for the best client outcome.
  • Create lasting value in the projects you work on, ensuring a user-centric, sustainable approach. 
  • Engage with Opencast in a meaningful way, supporting the growth of your practice and wider capability. 
  • Support Opencast's growth plans, by providing case studies and updates into the relevant forums of your project work. 
During the interview process, we'll ask questions to explore your experience across these areas. 

Salary

£50,000 - £60,000 per annum. 
 

What we offer

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations.  We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team. 
 

Where you’ll work 

This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role. 
 

We include you 

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.    
 

Interview 

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs. 
 

Want to know more?  

Visit our website or email

À propos du poste

En tant que Business Development Representative chez Amenitiz, vous prenez en charge l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact de prospection jusqu'à la signature du contrat. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste centré uniquement sur la prise de rendez-vous. Vous prospectez, réalisez des démonstrations, traitez les objections et concluez les ventes, tout en gérant votre pipeline et votre contribution au chiffre d'affaires de bout en bout.

Nos clients sont des hôteliers indépendants partout en Europe : des établissements familiaux, des hôtels-boutiques et de petites chaînes hôtelières insuffisamment servis par des solutions technologiques conçues pour les grands groupes. Avec plus de 15 000 clients et une note de satisfaction de 4,8/5, notre produit bénéficie d'une forte reconnaissance sur le marché.

Vous commercialiserez une solution qui a un impact concret et mesurable sur le quotidien de ses utilisateurs, tout en étant pleinement responsable de l'ensemble du processus qui leur permet d'y accéder.

(Ce rôle est basé à Lyon, en France)

Votre mission

  • Prospection et génération de pipeline

  • Identifiez et contactez de nouveaux clients potentiels par téléphone, e-mail et chat. Maintenez un niveau d'activité élevé et construisez un pipeline commercial solide à partir de zéro. Vous êtes responsable de l'ensemble de votre activité de prospection.

  • Découverte des besoins et qualification

  • Comprenez l'organisation actuelle de chaque prospect, ses problématiques et ses besoins opérationnels. Identifiez rapidement les opportunités pertinentes et positionnez Amenitiz de manière précise et adaptée à leur situation.

  • Démonstrations produit

  • Animez des démonstrations structurées et personnalisées qui établissent un lien direct entre les fonctionnalités du produit et les enjeux métier du prospect. Rendez la prise de décision simple et évidente.

  • Gestion des objections et closing

  • Traitez avec assurance les hésitations, les comparaisons avec la concurrence et les objections liées au timing. Créez un sentiment d'urgence lorsque cela est pertinent et sachez demander la signature.

  • Gestion du pipeline

  • Maintenez HubSpot à jour et garantissez la fiabilité des données. Réalisez des prévisions précises et assurez un suivi rigoureux de chaque opportunité.

  • Collaboration

  • Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables commerciaux et vos collègues afin d'améliorer en continu votre approche. Partagez les retours du marché, les objections récurrentes et les informations concurrentielles pour contribuer à la performance collective.

À propos de vous

  • Vous disposez de 2 à 4 ans d'expérience dans une fonction commerciale (SDR, Account Executive ou poste en cycle de vente complet).

  • Vous êtes de langue maternelle française, italienne, espagnole ou portugaise, et possédez un excellent niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour alterner entre des phases de prospection intensive et des phases de closing au cours d'une même semaine.

  • Vous assumez l'entière responsabilité de votre pipeline et de vos résultats, au-delà des simples indicateurs d'activité.

  • Vous adoptez une approche structurée de la gestion commerciale : vos prévisions sont fiables et votre suivi est irréprochable.

  • Vous faites preuve de résilience et de régularité dans un environnement exigeant, orienté objectifs et à fort volume d'activité.

  • Une expérience en SaaS, dans la technologie appliquée à l'hôtellerie ou en startup constitue un atout.
    La maîtrise de HubSpot ou d'un CRM similaire est appréciée.


Ce que nous offrons

  • Une rémunération attractive (OTE) composée d'un salaire fixe et de commissions déplafonnées basées sur la performance.

  • Des stock-options avec un calendrier d'acquisition progressif.

  • Une couverture santé complète.

  • Un accès anticipé à votre salaire, sans attendre la fin du mois.

  • Un parcours de carrière structuré, avec des critères d'évolution clairement définis à chaque niveau.

  • Des avantages flexibles permettant d'optimiser vos dépenses liées aux repas, à la garde d'enfants, aux transports et à la formation.

  • L'achat de tout livre professionnel dont vous avez besoin, ainsi qu'un accès à une bibliothèque partagée au sein de l'équipe.

  • Une équipe internationale composée de plus de 35 nationalités, basée dans l'un des principaux hubs technologiques européens.

data.description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role


At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale. You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.

You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.

To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.


Your responsibilities

  • Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

  • Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

  • Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

  • Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

  • Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

  • Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

  • Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

Tools we use

  • Amplitude, SQL, Looker

  • Figma

  • Notion

  • Slack

  • Enterpret

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

  • You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

  • You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

  • You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

  • You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

  • You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

  • You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

  • You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

  • You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

  • Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

  • Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

  • Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiments, major user journeys, and the metrics behind them

  • Start contributing to discovery and product discussions

Within 3 months, you will

  • Take ownership of a defined product area and its key user and business problems

  • Establish a trusted way of working with your Product Designer and Engineering counterparts

  • Lead your first discovery work and turn your findings into clear product opportunities

  • Launch and analyze your first experiments, using their results to inform your next decisions

Within 6 months, you will

  • Own the strategy and key initiatives for your product area end to end

  • Lead ambitious product bets that rethink meaningful parts of the user experience rather than isolated features

  • Drive measurable progress on outcomes such as retention, engagement, recommendation quality, monetization, or trust

  • Use data, user insight, and experimentation to decide what to scale, iterate, stop, or explore next

  • Raise the bar on product thinking, experimentation, and decision-making across Yubo

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with Anita, Talent Acquisition

  • First interview with Sacha, our CEO

  • Product case study and debrief with Product Managers

  • Cultural fit assessments

  • And if everything went well, an offer!

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A hybrid work policy with up to two days of on-site presence per week at an amazing office and monthly team events to enjoy.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

Le groupe Lovehoney est le leader mondial du bien-être sexuel. Sa mission est d’améliorer le plaisir grâce à des technologies innovantes et à une approche fondée sur les données, tout en favorisant des perspectives créatives et originales sur l’intimité. Nous proposons des marques passionnantes avec des sextoys, de la lingerie et des accessoires innovants et de haute qualité, le tout dans le cadre d’une expérience d’achat en ligne simplifiée.

Chez Lovehoney, nous employons plus de 800 personnes passionnées et avant-gardistes réparties dans 9 bureaux à travers le monde, chacune apportant un mélange unique de talents à notre effectif diversifié. Nous sommes fiers d’être une entreprise qui prospère en faisant les choses différemment, en remettant en question les attentes et les stéréotypes tout en ayant un impact positif sur la vie de nos clients.

Rejoignez-nous chez Lovehoney, où le plaisir s’allie à la créativité, aux données et à l’innovation !


Missions et Responsabilités

Nous recherchons, dans le cadre d'un CDD de remplacement temporaire,  un/e Category Manager  pour rejoindre notre équipe et prendre en charge la qualité, l’enrichissement et la performance de nos fiches produits sur nos deux sites e-commerce : espaceplaisir et SexyAvenue.

Vous n'êtes pas simplement en charge des fiches produit : vous êtes celui ou celle qui garantit que chaque produit est complet, bien présenté et connecté aux bons produits complémentaires sur Magento. Vous êtes garant(e) de la qualité des données produit, de la pertinence des associations cross-sell et de l'impact éditorial des fiches produit sur l'ensemble des sites (espaceplaisir, SexyAvenue), avec un objectif clair : maximiser la conversion et le panier moyen. 

Vos missions: 

1. Gestion des fiches produit sur Magento 

→  Créer, enrichir et maintenir les fiches produit sur Magento (catégorisation, attributs, stock, visuels, prix) 

→  Garantir la qualité et l'exhaustivité des données produit sur l'ensemble du catalogue (espaceplaisir, SexyAvenue) 

→  Assurer la mise en ligne des nouveautés et le suivi du cycle de vie produit (lancement, réassort, fin de vie), en veillant à ce que chaque nouveauté soit systématiquement poussée dans les bonnes catégories dès sa mise en ligne 

→  Décliner les produits configurables et les produits simples, et effectuer les rattachements adéquats 

→  Mettre à jour les anciennes fiches produit (adapter les visuels, le ton de marque, les recommandations SEO, etc.) 

2. Copywriting & contenus produit 

→  Rédiger et optimiser les fiches produit avec une véritable dimension éditoriale (titres, descriptions, argumentaires) 

→  Rédiger des points forts produit très catchy et marketing, capables de capter l'attention et de donner envie 

→  Adapter le ton de marque propre à chaque site (espaceplaisir et SexyAvenue conservent des discours volontairement différenciés) 

→  Rédiger les contenus catégories et les FAQ produits, en lien avec le SEO Manager 

→  Ajouter des vidéos sur les fiches produit pour enrichir l'expérience client 

→  Faire les demandes aux graphistes pour les contenus manquants côté groupe et/ou à adapter pour le marché français 

→  Intégrer les recommandations SEO (mots-clés, structure) directement dans la rédaction des fiches produit 

3. Cross-sell & merchandising produit 

→  Définir et paramétrer les associations de cross-sell et d'upsell sur les fiches produit 

→  Mettre en place des sélections de produits complémentaires pour maximiser le panier moyen 

→  Remplir l'ensemble des main catégories et veiller à la cohérence du fil d'Ariane et de l'arborescence du site 

→  Analyser la performance des cross-sell et ajuster les recommandations produit 

→  Collaborer avec l'E-Merchandising Manager sur le tri et la mise en avant des produits associés 

 


Profil recherché

Compétences techniques 

→  Maîtrise de Magento 2 (thème Hyvä) ou autre CMS — compétence indispensable 

→  Excellente maîtrise rédactionnelle en français, sens du storytelling produit 

→  Bonne compréhension des logiques de cross-sell et de merchandising produit 

→  Anglais professionnel indispensable (échanges réguliers avec les équipes groupe) 

→  Solides bases en SEO (recherche de mots-clés, bonnes pratiques on-page) 

→  Orienté(e) résultats : chaque action doit être mesurée et évaluée à l'aune de son impact sur la performance 

Compétences comportementales 

→  Rigueur, sens du détail et respect des délais de production 

→  Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main rapidement un nouvel outil (Magento) 

→  Aisance dans le travail transverse (E-Merchandising Manager, SEO, CRO) 

→  Curiosité pour les enjeux e-commerce et data 


Avantages chez Lovehoney Group France
  • Café et boissons à disposition
  • Fruits disponibles chaque semaine
  • Petit-déjeuner chaque premier lundi du mois
  • OpenUp : plateforme gratuite dédiée au bien-être et à la santé mentale
  • Salle de jeux avec baby-foot, tennis de table et fléchettes
  • Flexibilité concernant les horaires de travail et les congés payés
  • Télétravail (6 jours par mois)
  • Rattrapage des jours fériés tombant en weekend
  • Code promotionnel interne

    • Conditions du poste

    Dans le cadre du remplacement temporaire d’un salarié absent, nous proposons un CDD de remplacement jusqu'au 17 octobre 2026.

     


    Notre processus de recrutement

    • Examen du CV

    • Entretien téléphonique avec l’un des membres de l’équipe de recrutement

    • Entretien(s) avec le responsable du recrutement, l’équipe de recrutement et/ou avec la direction. Exercice/Cas pratique possible.

    Le groupe Lovehoney est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à évaluer chaque candidat qualifié en fonction de ses compétences, sans distinction d’âge, de handicap, de changement de genre, de mariage ou de partenariat civil, de grossesse ou de maternité, d’origine ethnique, de religion ou de convictions, de sexe ou d’orientation sexuelle.

    Si vous avez besoin d’aménagements particuliers pendant le processus de recrutement en raison d’un handicap, veuillez en informer votre spécialiste du recrutement afin que nous puissions garantir une expérience fluide et inclusive à tous les candidats.

    Chez Lovehoney Group, nous adoptons des technologies innovantes pour améliorer notre processus de recrutement. Teams across Scality, not only engineers, now build their own AI tools: skills, agents, connectors, websites. We want that to be fast, safe and shared, so nobody solves the same problem twice. Who are we?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ What is at stake in the coming months

  • Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

  • Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

  • Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

🎯 Your mission

  • Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy.

  • Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts.

  • Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together.

  • Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

  • Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.

  • Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country.

  • Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check.

  • Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers.

📈 How you will be measured

  • First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed.

  • 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed.

  • 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped.

🤩 This job is your dream job if:

  • You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory

  • You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal

  • You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting

  • You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2

  • You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it

🙅 This job is not for you if:

  • You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell

  • You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement

  • You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself

  • Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off

  • You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group

What we offer

  • A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa

  • Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE

  • Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea

🧭 Our recruitment process

  1. A first call to get to know each other.

  2. A deep dive into two deals you closed.

  3. A case study on a real Pelagon challenge, presented to the founders.

  4. A conversation with the founders.

  5. Reference checks, with your consent.

  6. Offer.

We answer after each step.

Pelagon is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a Data Analyst – Growth to own how Qonto measures whether its marketing spend actually works. You'll take charge of our attribution models and incrementality tests — geo tests, conversion lift studies — turning marketing spend across channels into evidence-backed decisions, under the guidance of Clotilde Pety, our Lead Data Analyst.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own attribution, end to end — maintain the attribution models and touchpoint definitions, and be the go-to when a stakeholder asks why the numbers moved.
  • Test where it matters, inside the ad platforms — design and run geo tests and conversion lift studies directly in Google Ads and Meta Ads.
  • Build the roadmap, not just answer tickets — pick up and drive the incrementality - testing roadmap within the first few months.
  • Referee, don't take sides — help channel teams and Finance agree on what the numbers actually say.
  • Use AI across the workflow, from making sense of a stakeholder's ask to shipping the dashboard that answers it.

  • Has owned an attribution model, not just read one — can explain last-click vs first-click and has navigated a real team disagreement over it.

data.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The internship

You'll shape how Homa communicates, inside and out. You'll operate at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and AI, turning complex ideas into sharp content that lands with every audience: talent, game studios, partners, investors, and our own teams. There's no shadow work. What you create will be published, presented, and read. You'll develop a 360° understanding of Homa by working with every function, while building your writing, design, and AI skills.

What you'll do

  • Build. Design AI-powered content systems (workflows, prompt libraries, templates) so the team can produce more, faster, without losing quality.
  • Create. Produce high-impact content fast: LinkedIn posts, blog articles, employer branding, internal decks, and strategic presentations.
  • Produce. Use AI tools for images, video, and copy to create high-performing creatives and content for our games.
  • Monitor trends. Track social media trends, competitor content, and new AI tools to stay ahead.
  • Elevate. Spot high-impact opportunities, introduce better formats and tools, and raise the bar for how Homa informs, inspires, and engages.

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
  • Real ownership, early. Your projects will change how Homa operates, and you'll see the results.
  • Learn from leadership. You'll work alongside leaders and people who make decisions.
  • A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.
  • AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works.

Requirements

  • Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes, when something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain something complex in a few sentences.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.
  • Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this internship as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.
  • Bonus: you've built something. A game, an app, a student initiative, a side business. We'd love to hear about it.

For this role, you'll also bring:

  • You've created content in some form: a blog, a TikTok page, a newsletter, a portfolio, a standout university project. Show us. We care about what you've made, not where you made it.
  • Sharp writing. You write and speak with clarity and punch, adapt to any audience, and work confidently with anyone.
  • Design instinct. You're fluent in content tools (slides, Canva, Figma, or similar) and build clean, high-quality visuals.

Practical details

  • A 6-month internship, with a flexible start date. We adapt to any month.
  • A convention de stage (internship agreement) is required.
  • Apprenticeships (alternance) are also welcome.
  • Paris based. You'll need to be able to work onsite at our Paris office.
  • Fluent English is required. French is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Top performers may be offered a full-time role at the end of the internship

Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

data.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will take Alta Ares’ autonomous air-defense systems from the lab to the field, deploying, integrating, testing, troubleshooting and improving them alongside military operators and customers.

You will work at the intersection of Engineering, Product and Operations, across our interceptors, AI guidance, mission-management software, sensors and customer C2 systems.

This is not a traditional support role. You will own technical outcomes in real operational environments, often under time pressure and with incomplete information. You should be equally comfortable writing code, debugging systems, analysing telemetry and working directly with operators on a test range.

Deployment & Field Operations

  • Prepare and execute customer deployments, live-fire exercises, demonstrations and acceptance trials.

  • Deploy and validate Alta Ares systems, including interceptors, AI guidance and Cyclops mission-management capabilities.

  • Configure systems, networks and interfaces and execute test scenarios against defined success criteria.

  • Work directly with military operators, test teams, integrators and partners.

  • Troubleshoot issues rapidly in the field while maintaining safety and mission objectives.

  • Document test results, incidents, lessons learned and follow-up actions.

Systems Integration

  • Integrate Alta Ares systems with sensors, radars, C2 systems, networks and third-party platforms.

  • Develop scripts, configuration tools, APIs and integration components required for deployments.

  • Translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Execute integration and acceptance testing across software, hardware, communications and system performance.

  • Work closely with Software, AI, Embedded, GNC, Hardware and Product teams.

Troubleshooting & Product Improvement

  • Diagnose issues across software, hardware, GNC, sensors, networking, communications, and operator workflows.

  • Use logs, telemetry and test data to identify root causes.

  • Implement safe field workarounds and drive permanent fixes with Engineering.

  • Improve system observability, diagnostics, deployment automation, and reliability.

  • Contribute to hardening systems for GNSS-denied, disconnected, and degraded environments.

  • Turn field experience into concrete product improvements and reusable solutions.

Customer & Technical Interface

  • Build trusted relationships with military operators, engineers, integrators, and program stakeholders.

  • Deliver technical briefings, training, and system onboarding in English and French.

  • Communicate system capabilities, limitations, and technical risks clearly.

  • Represent Alta Ares with technical credibility during high-stakes demonstrations and exercises.

  • Create deployment guides, runbooks, and troubleshooting procedures.


Candidate Profile

  • 3–7 years in software engineering, systems integration, robotics, embedded systems, DevOps/SRE, solutions engineering or a similar hands-on technical role.

  • Strong Python and Linux skills, with good understanding of networking, APIs, logs and distributed systems.

  • Proven experience deploying and debugging complex hardware/software systems outside a controlled development environment.

  • Ability to understand and troubleshoot systems end-to-end.

  • Experience with UAVs, robotics, autonomous systems, AI/ML, sensors or mission-management systems is highly relevant.

  • Defense, aerospace, C-UAS, ISR or other mission-critical experience is a strong plus.

  • Experience working directly with demanding customers or end users in the field is highly valued.

Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on and technically curious, comfortable moving between code, hardware, networks, telemetry, and field operations.

  • Calm and structured under pressure, with strong operational judgment.

  • High ownership and able to solve ambiguous problems independently.

  • Strong communicator who can translate between operators and engineering teams.

  • Pragmatic, balancing speed, performance, safety and maintainability.

  • Comfortable with frequent travel and flexible hours during deployments and exercises.

  • Fluent English required; professional French strongly preferred.

  • High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive defense technologies.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment.
