data.description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Process Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Process Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on dry etching processes, particularly ICP and RIE, as well as PECVD and metal evaporation. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

  • Develop, optimize and stabilize semiconductor fabrication processes, with a primary focus on ICP / RIE dry etching, PECVD deposition and metal evaporation. 
  • Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. 
  • Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
  • Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. 
  • Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
  • Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. 

R&D to Production Transfer 

  • Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. 
  • Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. 
  • Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. 
  • Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
  • Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. 
  • Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. 
  • Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. 

Process Control & Yield Improvement 

  • Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. 
  • Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. 
  • Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. 
  • Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. 
  • Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. 

Equipment & Production Support 

  • Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. 
  • Support equipment qualification, troubleshooting and process recovery following equipment interventions. 
  • Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 

Process Characterization & Data Analysis 

  • Characterize the impact of fabrication parameters on material and device performance. 
  • Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. 
  • Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. 
  • Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. 
  • Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. 

Documentation & Communication 

  • Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. 
  • Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 
  • Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience 

  • Master's degree or PhD in Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
  • Strong knowledge of dry etching, ideally including hands-on experience with ICP-RIE. 
  • Experience with one or more complementary processes such as RIE, PECVD, physical vapor deposition / metal evaporation and lithography. 
  • Strong understanding of how fabrication parameters can influence material properties and device performance. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
  • Strong communication and documentation skills. 
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. 
  • Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
  • Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. 
  • Experience with optical and electrical characterization of semiconductor or optoelectronic devices. 
  • Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. 
  • Knowledge of Python or other programming languages for process-data analysis, automated reporting, instrument control or experimental automation. 

Profile 

We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new processes where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. 

You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, solving complex fabrication problems and collaborating across R&D and production teams. 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

    • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
    • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
    • Use Case / Practical Assessment : The use case will consist of a simple practical exercise focused on the alignment of an optical bench. The assessment will take place in the cleanroom, they are not considered PPE for this exercise.
    • Meeting with the teams
    • 2 reference check
    • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

data.description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient quantum processing units that scale, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

With a team of more than 140 people, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and quantum algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation using Quandela's cutting-edge quantum dot technology.

Achieving this vision requires not only advances in photonic quantum computing, but also the development of scalable spin-photon interfaces, distributed entanglement capabilities and future SPOQC (Spin-Optical Quantum Computing) architectures that will enable modular and fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About this position:

Join Quandela’s Source Production team to work on the fiber pigtailing of single-photon sources.
The role focuses on developing, improving and operating highly precise fiber coupling methods for photonic quantum devices.

The role is part of the Source Production team, which currently includes 11 people across fabrication, fiber pigtailing and optical characterization. The role is part of the pigtail team, currently composed of one person, and works in close interaction with the fabrication and characterization teams.

The objective is to improve the reliability, reproducibility and productivity of the pigtailing process, from prototype development to production-ready methods.

Key responsibilities

  • Perform high-precision fiber coupling between single-mode fibers and individual micropillars, with alignment precision below 100 nm 
  • Work on fiber preparation and assembly steps, including:

Skeleton is the Backbone of Power: equipping AI data centers, electrical grids, defense systems, and critical infrastructure with the resilience to withstand surges, instability, and failure. Our power systems protect GPU clusters from millisecond-level spikes, enable hyperscalers to run at higher rack densities without grid compromise, and make AI data centers up to more 40% energy efficient. When power fails, critical operations stop. We exist to prevent that in microseconds. Powering the infrastructure that powers everything else.

OPENING FROM KRAKEN TECHNOLOGIES FRANCE 🇫🇷 - ALL LOCATIONS

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

 

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

 

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

 

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

Our mission is to provide cheaper, greener energy to the French market.

 

Octopus Energy France is a fast-growing energy company recognized as an ESS (social economy). **We offer a better experience to our customers through transparency, honesty and simplicity. We want to do better for the planet, through real, long-term investment in renewable energy production and a low-CO2 future that's better for our customers' wallets. We want to revolutionize the energy business through our people, our platform and our use of data.

 

Our focus is on customer satisfaction, and receiving positive reviews is important to us - we have the best score among French energy suppliers on Google Reviews and Trust Pilot.

 

Kraken technologies

 

Kraken Technologies is a company within Octopus Energy Group who are licensing the Kraken platform and operating model to clients across the world. Current clients are both the Octopus Energy retails businesses around the world as well as external clients such as Good Energy, Origin, EDF, E.ON & Queensland Energy - with many more expected to join over the next few years!

 

Our team

 

All technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 450 people globally. This includes server-side, client-side and mobile engineers working closely with UX experts, copywriters and designers.

We follow a Kanban-like approach, using Google docs and Asana to specify and manage work; Github, CircleCI and Terraform Enterprise as part of an immutable-infrastructure, continuous delivery pipeline; and Loggly, Sentry and Cloudwatch to measure performance and monitor production.

Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

Octopus is a great place to learn, work with some talented engineers and level-up your skills.

 

Our technology

 

On the server-side, we mainly use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and the Django-REST-framework. We also use Pandas, Numpy and Jupyter for analysis and forecasting, plus Celery, RabbitMQ, SQS and Airflow for background processing.

 

We use AWS heavily, employing most of the "Hashistack" (eg Packer, Consul, Terraform) as part of a continuous deployment pipeline. See, for example, Django, ELB health checks and continuous delivery.

 

Client-side, we use React, Redux and SASS; our mobile apps are built using native code or React Native.

 

🚀 What you’ll own

  • We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The French energy market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

  • You will be working in a multi-disciplinary software engineering team; solving design challenges; domain modeling; solving technical problems; engineering solutions for smart meters, writing robust fault-tolerant software primarily in Python and Django, Celery, and async processing

  • We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The energy market is complicated, outdated, and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modeling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

  • We have difficult technical problems to solve. With the advent of smart meters, we'll soon be processing millions of meter readings a day.

  • There's a great opportunity for disruption in the energy market. The big suppliers still dominate but are not exactly popular. The energy landscape is changing as we move to more disaggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism, and smarter technology. Octopus Energy was the first UK supplier to introduce a "tracker" tariff whose prices track the daily wholesale prices: http://www.cleanenergynews.co.uk/news/efficiency/octopus-offerstransparency-with-wholesale-price-tariff

  • You'll be working for a company that’s fighting climate change. Our parent company is the largest investor in solar generation in the UK and is funding wind and anaerobic digestion. As a supplier, we're helping people to use greener technology and renewable energy, all helping move the world towards a lower carbon future.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • AWS

Lead a growing business operations field partnership team that helps regional sales leaders turn business insight into focused execution and sustainable growth.

You will partner with three regional VPs across Northern, Central and Southern Europe, supporting approximately 50–60 account executives. You will develop the team’s ability to advise leaders, solve commercial problems and drive action.

Global Revenue Operations provides pipeline analytics and business insight. Your team will translate those insights into regional priorities, practical interventions and measurable results, with clear ownership and consistent follow-through.

You will also work closely with GTM Systems, gathering feedback from sellers and sales leaders to identify process gaps and opportunities for AI and automation that reduce manual work and help teams move faster.

Key responsibilities

  1. Lead and develop the team. Coach and prioritize the work of a growing business operations field partnership team, with clear regional coverage, accountability and development plans.

  2. Partner with regional leadership. Translate EMEA growth objectives into quarterly priorities, market focus, account coverage and resource allocation.

  3. Own territory planning and execution. Lead territory design, rollout and ongoing management with Sales and global RevOps; align account allocation to market potential, seller capacity and ramp, and resolve coverage gaps.

  4. Drive capacity and quota planning. Partner with Sales, Finance and global RevOps on headcount, capacity and regional quotas; translate plans into territory targets and track attainment.

  8. Turn insight into action. Interpret global analytics in regional context, diagnose root causes, agree interventions and measure results. Feed field context and unanswered questions back to global RevOps.

  9. Improve productivity through AI and automation. Gather seller and leadership feedback, prioritize opportunities with GTM Systems, define requirements, pilot improvements and measure adoption, time saved and execution speed.

  10. Deliver cross-functional change. Represent EMEA in global initiatives and coordinate regional adoption with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Enablement and GTM Systems. Equip managers to embed improvements in daily execution.

Must-haves

  • Experience leading and developing sales operations, revenue operations or commercial business partnership teams.

About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

The best of AI at the service of healthcare

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership.

Engineering at Nabla

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your Team

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As an AI Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

What you'll do

As an AI/ML Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our engineering team and product.

Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Meta, Google, and Microsoft, you will:

  • Build agentic pipelines: chains of LLM-based agents that work together on complex clinical documentation tasks.

  • Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care.

  • Integrate LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others) into production features.

  • Design prompts and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality, then iterate quickly based on results.

  • Write clean, production-grade code and own your features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring in a live healthcare setting.

  • Work closely with product managers to turn model capabilities into reliable, scalable product features.

To get a sense of the impact you’ll have:

  • Nabla processes 300 billion tokens/month with LLMs.

  • By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes, saving 125 hours of doctor time.

Your DNA:

The ideal candidate will bring strong software engineering skills and a practical, hands-on approach to building with LLMs.

  • You have 3+ years writing production code, with solid skills in software design, testing, and system architecture.

  • You’re proficient in one or more widely used back-end languages (Java, Kotlin, C++, Go, etc.).

  • You’ve built features or products using LLM provider APIs, including prompting and evaluation. You don’t need to have trained or fine-tuned models yourself.

  • You can turn a fuzzy product requirement into a working, testable pipeline.

  • You have a passion for going beyond the status quo to redefine workflows and unlock better care for patients.

  • You communicate clearly and effectively.

  • Bonus: Experience building multi-agent systems or agent orchestration frameworks is a strong plus.

Our Stack

  • Kotlin for backend services

  • LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and others) for the models themselves

  • Agent orchestration frameworks for building chains of agents

  • Prompt evaluation and testing tools to track output quality over time

  • Google Cloud & Kubernetes for deployment

Where you'll be based

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers).
Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

  • Stock ownership

  • 100% healthcare coverage

  • Meal vouchers

  • Public transportation costs covered at 50%

  • Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT

  • Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare

  • Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

About Abacum

We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

Bonus points if you have...

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get

Benefits

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.


Please make your application, including your CV, in English Language. We are a global compliance team headquartered out of London.

About the role

As a Senior Analyst – Permanent Controls, you will join the Permanent Controls team, a global Second Line of Defence (2LoD) function based across Paris and Mauritius. Reporting directly to the Head of Permanent Controls within the Compliance department, you will focus on the financial perimeter, exercising second-line control, independent oversight, and framework monitoring over the organization's finance domain. You will partner closely with the First Line of Defence (1LoD) to establish control standards, design control matrices, and provide guidance when needed. You will also execute 2LoD control plans, issue formal findings, and track recommendations through to resolution.

 

Sitting in the Second Line of Defense, the global Permanent Controls team serves as an ongoing, trusted advisor and objective challenge to operational teams (1LoD), helping them design robust controls and ensure operational integrity across the organization.

Unlike periodic audit functions, Permanent Controls operates continuously to proactively identify vulnerabilities, standardize control frameworks, and foster a strong risk culture.

 

Note on Governance: This is a 2LoD function focused on ongoing control design, execution, and 1LoD enablement. It is distinct and independent from the Internal Audit (3LoD) function within Checkout.com.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Control Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to translate identified risks into comprehensive 2nd line control plans, standards, and templates.

  • 1LoD Enablement: Partner with the First Line of Defence teams to design, refine, and assess their control matrices, ensuring alignment with internal standards and regulators' expectations (ACPR, FCA..).

  • Execution & Testing: Formalize and execute second line permanent controls across critical perimeters, including:

    • Financial regulatory reporting across global entities (France, UK, US, etc.).

    • Accuracy of financial data, accounting standards, and reconciliations.

    • Internal financial processes, procedures, and statutory compliance (including the Order of 3 December 2014).

    • Safeguarding mechanisms (flow of funds, compliance with safeguarding measures, timelines, and incident monitoring).

  • Reporting & Escalation: Present detailed control findings and anomaly reports to the Head of Permanent Controls; track the implementation of remediation recommendations.

  • Proactive Continuous Improvement: Identify operational control gaps, take the initiative to propose practical solutions, and drive improvements to the overall control framework.

  • Tooling & Automation: Contribute to the implementation and optimization of automated control tools, tracking dashboards, and recommendation monitoring systems whenever possible.

 

About You

  • Experience: 5 years of experience in Financial Audit, Internal Control, or Financial Reporting within the financial services (banking, Fintech..) or payments industry.

  • Regulatory Context: Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and ACPR expectations is strongly preferred.

  • Mindset & Working Style:

    • Proactive & Autonomous: A "go-getter" who takes ownership, anticipates control gaps, and brings actionable solutions to the table rather than waiting for direction.

    • Naturally Curious: A drive to understand end-to-end business operations, data flows, and complex payment mechanics.

    • Rigorous & Analytical: Meticulous attention to detail with an ability to leverage data analytics to evaluate controls, transactions and processes objectively.

  • Languages: Fluency in French and English is required.

  • Communication: Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate clear findings and influence decision-making across lines of defence.

 

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

  • Strong interest in AI and the ability to keep up with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and its impact on software and business processes

  • Excellent communication and customer-facing skills, with the ability to build credibility and trust with both technical and business stakeholders

  • Ability to clearly explain and articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences

  • Strong business process mapping skills and the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions

  • Experience responding to technical questions, security requirements, and due diligence requests from customers

data.title: (Senior) Sales Manager Schweiz (m|w|d) | Marktexpansion SaaS Full Service Lösung

data.description:
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

  • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

  • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

  • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

  • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

  • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


Why us?

  • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

  • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

  • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

When something fails on site and nobody can yet say whether it's a driver or a solder joint, you are the person who finds out.

  • Be the low level link between hardware and software teams; the person who can tell a driver bug from a hardware fault.

  • Drive our OTA update and recovery strategy for machines around the world

  • Implement security hardening: secure boot, disk encryption, container isolation, vulnerability patching.

The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

 

Responsibilities

  • Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

  • MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

  • Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

  • BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

  • High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

  • EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

  • Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

  • Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

  • Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

  • Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics.

  • Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design: gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

  • Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification): ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

  • Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

  • Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug.

  • Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed.

  • Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership.

  • English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As an Electrical Engineer, your main role will be to design and develop electronic boards and embedded systems (SoM) for UAVs (e.g., Flight Controllers, Companion Computers, Electronic Speed Controllers).

 

Responsibilities

  • High-performance embedded system design: Define the architecture and design the physical and electrical integration of complex systems based on processors, fast memory (DDR, Flash), and peripherals (e.g. embedded computers/calculators, sensors, video processing…).

  • Advanced schematic and routing design: Design and develop electronic schematics, and perform board placement/routing to meet design specifications, managing fast signal constraints.

  • Physical integration: Collaborate with the Mechanical Department to ensure the seamless physical integration of the boards into the final product.

  • Sensor integration: Work closely with the GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) Department to ensure accurate and effective sensor integration.

  • Electromagnetic compatibility: Address and resolve EMC challenges while ensuring signal integrity.

  • Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues in electrical and electronic boards through effective troubleshooting.

  • Testing and Validation: Conduct testing, integration, and performance validation of electronic boards to meet operational and design requirements.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • Technical Expertise:

    • Demonstrated experience of 5 years minimum in complex electronic system design.

    • In-depth knowledge of processors, memory domains (DDR, Flash), and electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

  • Testing Proficiency: Proficiency in using electronic test equipment.

  • Additional Skills: Experience with Robotics or Aerospace systems is a strong advantage.

  • Problem-Solving: Ability to work autonomously and solve complex technical challenges.

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of interacting with diverse principals—from junior members to senior executives.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

data.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly.

Responsibilities

  • Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms.

  • High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity.

  • Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication.

  • Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs.

  • Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification.

Candidate requirements

  • Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production.

  • Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

  • Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production.

  • Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required.

Key position responsibilities:

  • Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

  • Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

  • Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

  • Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

  • Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

  • Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

  • Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

  • Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in German and English

  • Familiarity and ability to communicate value and competitive advantages

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. Applicants with disabilities are welcome and encouraged. About the Opportunity

We are expanding our talent network and seeking skilled Wolof-language professionals with expertise in user interfaces, marketing localization, and retail content. Our ideal partners possess a nuanced command of market-specific nuances and consumer expectations. We value linguists who excel at software localization and brand storytelling, ensuring every string is clear, consistent, and culturally impactful.

What You'll Deliver

  • Precision in UX and Technical Content. Adapt complex software interfaces and support documentation with total accuracy, ensuring terminological rigor and a seamless experience for native Wolof users.

  • Impactful Marketing Localization. Transform global campaigns and brand voices to hit home in the Wolof-speaking market, maintaining the original creative spirit while maximizing local relevance.

  • Polished Product and E-commerce Copy. Localize product and UI listings applying regional naming logic and formatting standards.

  • Brand Integrity and Quality Assurance. Uphold elite quality benchmarks to provide engaging, audience-centric content aligned with brand identity.

  • Agile Team Collaboration. Coordinate with our production and quality leads to execute high-stakes projects on schedule and within client specifications.

Qualifications

  • Native-level proficiency in Wolof.

  • A graduate qualification in translation, linguistics, or language studies, OR a graduate qualification in another field plus 2 years of full-time professional translation experience, OR 5 years of full-time professional translation experience.

  • The ability to follow terminology and reference materials precisely.

  • Proven professional experience in translation and localization within marketing, UI/software, or e-commerce content.

  • Experience with app or platform localization (mobile UI, social media, or web content) preferred.

Why Collaborate with LILT?

  • Your schedule, your rules. As an independent contractor, work when you want, as much or as little as you want. No fixed hours, no check-ins, no micromanaging.

  • Get paid quickly and fairly. Competitive rates, prompt payments, no chasing invoices.

  • Work on projects that actually matter. Contribute to cutting-edge AI and language technology shaping how humans and machines communicate.

  • Be part of something bigger. Join a global community of linguists, subject matter experts, and language professionals advancing human knowledge together.

  • Grow without limits. Access diverse, innovative projects that expand your portfolio and sharpen your skills across industries and domains.

  • Have fun doing what you love. Bring your language skills to life on projects that are as interesting as they are impactful.

What to Consider Before Applying

  • Not ideal as a full-time job or primary income source. Work availability fluctuates with project demand; as a 1099 contractor, you won't receive benefits such as health insurance, paid time off, or retirement contributions, and hours are not guaranteed.

  • Requires reliable availability and commitment. Most tasks require a minimum of 2 hours per day or 10 hours per week.

  • Geographic restrictions may apply. We cannot engage contractors in regions subject to international embargo or sanctions. As a 1099 contractor, you are solely responsible for your own tax obligations.

How to Join Our Expert Community

  1. Submit your application, including an updated copy of your CV in English.

  2. If a test is required, you will be asked to take a test in the domain(s) you specialize in.

  3. Once selected and you've passed the test, we'll guide you through onboarding — completing an application form, getting you set up for payments, and welcoming you into our community.

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team.

We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build.

This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional.

What You Will Do

  • Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers.

  • Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder.

  • Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up.

  • Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling.

  • Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made.

  • Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience in B2B product marketing, ideally in enterprise software, with a track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, not just contributing pieces of it.

  • A real competitive intelligence practice under your belt. You've built and maintained a program that sales relied on, not just responded to research requests as they came in.

  • Comfort marketing technical products to technical buyers. You can go deep enough into a technical concept to be credible with a developer, and simplify it enough to be clear to an executive.

  • Field enablement experience at scale. You've built programs that changed how a sales team talked about a product, and you know how to tell if it worked.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to build trust with product and sales without relying on authority, and how to bring people along on a positioning decision rather than just announcing it.

  • Comfort using AI tools in your day to day work. This isn't a checkbox, it's part of how the role actually operates.

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.


Your Impact

Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.


Your Profile

  • 5 years  experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D  and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.


Bonus Points
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

    • What We Offer

    • The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

    • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.
